tei:div.tei:p: ge ri cho sketsho sto ca ci snyodzilnge zu sne— rnye chi dzā cho—4rme rdzo rdzo la cho phro rnyoci // chi /tsho7r+sha3wa/༷ ngh+ru sau ) — cirkish+tsa/ / wa/khroli 9 ṅka 4khugus4 haṃ/// —wawa— riri ji sna0 〉 rmestekyi shaṃ wa ske ci d+nghad+ngha‘ 4 ji ge rte rithe rteX4— ༷gu cilha 〉 stib rte ) ngh+ru tre — karma nges don bstan 'jin h+phun lasarabatwas/ trī ༷ ci rī ne+e trecho~Xspro 3 chiwaXsdu ༷— ‘rīd+ngha ljohū+oṃbyedu sto ske+ot+pāstsoldiṣ+ṭi rīrī rme—rīsngu (rme rineṭashā// ༷)ci )no rmye nyusku — snyohūṃskre me/dīXd+dha rmo() lngelhu ri ṣe ci—tre dzi tshe ri) rdo((/ khriXsdi/ hūṃ)kātshi me+eji /ri ṭī+o n+da trīsnyo/ rki’rjo ri3‘shaṃ/ snye ci shaṃ rdo+o+owadzhamotsho—phrokhe ngatho — rīrdzutshibe+e ṭa spu he 1tho7tsho wa/ dzādzetsho— ༷rter+sharme — rkekyi — d+ngha— rukyi/ ///ḍo paṃ/sna(/ dze snotshoṭā rmo sna mi ——wo/ dzitshomo 'i /tshe// de rde gyi zloX( thu+o1༷sdowamowasho3sdu/—dzo/ — sprerdowaji— t+t+waṃ tre rwalhu ne zhe tsho la — smi 3 —/kau
glo7 kretshe

sngon 'gro'i gtam/ bod kyi gso ba rig pa la lo ngo bzhi stong la nye ba'i lo rgyus ldan la/ de ni gna' bo'i bod kyi gso rig rmang gzhir byas thog rgya gar rgya nag ta zig la sogs pa'i gso ba rig pa'i nying bcud bsdu len byas nas grub pa zhig yin la/gzhung lugs kyi ma lag cha tshang zhing lag len gyi myong byang phun sum tshogs pa dang / mi rigs kyi khyad chos mngon par bkra ba'i gso dpyad kyi rig pa zhig yin pas na/ snga mo zhig nas 'dzam gling khyab khongs kyi gso rig smra ba rnams kyis gdeng 'jog chen po gnang mus su mchis/bod kyi gso ba rig pa la gzhung dang lag len gyi bstan bcos bgrang las 'das pa zhig yod pa ste/ de ni nang don gyi thad gso rig lo rgyus dang /rmang gzhi'i gzhung lugs/ nad thog lag len/ sman rdzas sdeb bzo/ lus khams bde srung la sogs rig tshan yongs su 'dus yod pa'i nor bu'i bang mdzod cig lags/ de la tang dang srid gzhung gi thugs 'khur dang brtsi mthong chen po'i 'og nye lor bod kyi gso ba rig pa rgyun 'dzin dang dar spel gang legs byung yod la/ gna' gzhung gang mang zhig kyang dpe skrun 'grems spel byas zin yod/ yin na yang da dung gna' dpe mang po zhig sngar bzhin 'bus zos rul gog thebs pa'am/ yang na mi'i rtsol ba'i dbang gis gtor brlag tshabs chen thebs kyi yod pas/ gang myur sgos srung skyob ma byas tshe rin thangagazhal du med pa'i gna' dpe gang mang zhig rtsa brlag rgyun chad du 'gro nyen che/de la bod kyi gso ba rig pa nyid phyogs yongs nas rgyun 'dzin dang dar 1

spel gtong rgyu'i dmigs yul bcangs nas nga tshos 2༷02lor mtsho sngon zhing chen bod kyi gso rig zhib 'jug khang gis gtso khrid byas pa'i ‘‘〈bod kyi gso ba rig pa'i gna' dpe phyogs bsgrigs dpe tshogs〉rtsom sgrig tshogs pa sgrig 'dzugs byas pa dang / gna' dpe 'tshol sdud dang dag sgrig dang rtsom sgrig bcas kyi las sgo phye zhing dpe skrun dang 'grems spel gyi bya ba yang 'go brtsams zin yod/ dpe tshogs 'di ni snga na ma mchis pa'i rig gnas kyi las grwa chen po zhig yin la/ 'di nyid bod kyi gso ba rig pa'i gna' dpe yod do cog 'dus pa'i dpe tshogs shig tu 'gyur bar byed rgyu ni nga tsho'i bsam 'dun yin la/ de ltar byed thub pa'i yid ches kyang nga tshor yod/de ltar dpe tshogs 'di thog mar dpe skrun byed pa'i sgo dang bstun nas 'dir kho bos bya bzhag chen po 'di phyogs gang thad nas bya ba lam lhong yong ba'i bkra shis smon 'dun zhu rgyu dang / de bzhin bod kyi gso ba rig pa la lhag bsam dkar ba'i yul dang phyogs so so'i skyes bu kun nas kyang las grwa 'dir phyogs gang thad nas rgyab skyor dang rogs 'degs byed pa'i bsam 'dun zhu rgyu yin/ zhes 'o tshogs chen nas/2rkya04lo'i zla 2par/2

mtshams smyor ba'i gtam/kha ba ri bo'i bcu phrag 3ga gnas zhes bya ba ni bod mi rigs kyis 'jig rtenaspyi'i phan bde gzhi mar gyur pa'i blo'i rig pa mtha' dag spyi la btags pa'i ming zhig yin la/ de las gzhan rjes 'dzin gyi thabs mchog dam par gyur pa'i gangs can gso ba rig pa ni bod mi rigs rang nyid kyis srol rgyun dar spel mdzad cing 'gro ba mi'i rigs la phan pa 'ba' zhig sgrub pa'i rig pa zhig yin stabs/ ris su ma chad pa'i 'gro ba mi'i rigs la phan pa'i las don kho na sgrub pa'i rig pa zhig tu 'khums shing spyi tshogs dang dus rabs ji 'dra zhig gi nang du'ang mkho gal dang phan thogs che ba zhig yin pa ni don dngos kyi steng nas grub pa'i gnas lugs shig yin pas mi su dang su zhig gis kyang bsnyon 'ding dang khyog bshad bya bar mi nus so/ / rang re'i lo rgyus yig tshang dang da yod bstan bcos kyi dkar chag ltar na/ g.yung drung bon lugs kyi drang srong dpyad bu khri shes nas sman pa dung gi thor cog can bar dang / rje btsun g.yu thog rnying ma yon tan mgon po nas gter ston gra ba mngon shes kyi bar/ be+e ro tsa na nas lo chen rin chen bzang po'i skabs/ byang zur rnam gnyis nas kong sprul yab sras/ mi dbang sde srid rin po che nas sman rtsis mkhas dbang mkhyen rab nor bu la thug pa'i drang srong mkhas grub rim byon bgrang gis mi langs pa rnams kyi sku drin las/ dpal ldan rgyud bzhi'i dgongs 'grel dang yan lag brgyad pa'i dgongs 'grel gtso byas pa'i gso rig gi bstan bcos ri bo'i gtos dang mnyam pa rang gis mjal na dad pa'i 1

spu long g.yo zhing gzhan la ngom na la rgya'i spobs pa rgyas pa 'dis bod kyi gso ba rig pa'i lo rgyus ring la gzhung man ngag gi nang don phun sum tshogs pa zhig yin pa ra sprod gsal po byas 'duga'on kyang mig sngar phyi nang gi rgyu rkyen du ma'i dbang gis rang re'i gso rig thad kyi gzhung man ngag gi gdams pa mang pojig nyams nyes su gyur dang 'gyur mus yin pa'ang kun gyis mkhyen gsal lags pas/ da lta'i dus 'dir bdag cag tshe rig 'dzin pa rnams kyis tshong zong kho na dang yul lung bye brag pa'i khe phan nam phyogs ris can gyi lta ba sogs ring du dor nas mi rigs kyi rig gnas yid bzhin nor bu lta bu 'di la snying khong nas sha tsha dang gces spras/ de bzhin ris su med pa'i 'dzam gling gi mi'i rigs yongs la phan du re ba'i kun slong rnam dag gi sgo nas/ ri rgyal lhun po'i gtos dang mnyam pa'i bod lugs gso rig gi gzhung man ngag rnams la 'ol tshod dang rang bzo tsam ma yin par sngar las lhag pa'i ngang sngog 'don myur skyob dang 'tshol sdud legs sgrig byed rgyu bcas ni shin tu gal gnad che ba'i bgyi ba zhig red//de'i phyir mtsho sngon zhing chen bod kyi gso rig zhib 'jug khang gis ming don mtshungs pa'i sgo nas bod kyi sman rtsis rig pa rgyud 'dzin yag po zhig dang gsar btod gong spel gyi rmang gzhi brtan po zhig 'dzugs thub pa'i ched du/da lta'i dus rabs dang srid jus bzang po'i go skabs dam 'dzin ngang mi dngos nor gsum gyi stobs shugs gcig tu bsgril zhing mig rgyang ring ba'i jus gzhi dang bcas te rang re'i sman rtsis skor gyi mkho gal che ba'i gna' dpe dang bstan bcosatsholag tu zin to cog phyogs gcig tu bsgrigs te par du bskrun pa'i dge ba 'dis/ da lta tsam ma zad 'byung 'gyur bod kyi sman rtsis bstan pa nyid yar rgyas gong 'phel du 'gro bar bsam yul lasa'adas pa'i 2

nus pa thon thub cing lus can kun gyi srog 'tsho'i dpal du 'gyur bar gdon mi za bas na/ 'o skol thun mong gis rjes su yi rang zhu 'os pa'i las don gal chen zhig red ces ha cang dga' tshor dang bcas mtshams sbyor ba'i tshig tu/(thokhro ru tshe rnam gyis/spyi lo 2skyu02lo'i zla 11tshes 1nyin la/

dag sgrig pa'i gsal bshad/ —bodazal mo sgang ba zhes su grags pa 'dzam gling gi yang steng du gnas pa'i mi rigs nyid la gnam gyis sa bkab pa lta bu'i sngon byon dran dbang dam pa rnams kyi bka' drin las/ dam pa'i chos kyis gtsos pa'i bcu phrag rig pa'i gnas kyis yongs su phyug pa'i shes rig bang mdzod ni srid pa'i mthar yang nub pa med pa zhig mchis pa la sus kyang bsnyon du med do// de las gnas bcu'i ya gyal gzhan rjes 'dzin gyi thabs mchog dam par gyur pa'i bod kyi gso ba rig pa ni/ rje g.yu thog chen pos/ mi na bar gnas par 'dod pa dang na ba gso bar 'dod pa'i gang zag gis gso ba rig pa'i man ngag la bslab par bya'o zhes gsungs pa bzhin ris su ma chad pa'i 'gro ba mi'i rigs la phan pa 'ba' zhig sgrub pa'i rig pa zhig ste/ der lo rgyus kyi dus yun ha cang ring zhing gzhung lugs kyi ma lag cha tshang yin pa ma zad/ sman dpyad kyi rigs lam khyad du 'phags shing man ngag nyams myong phun sum tshogs shing gya nom pa zhig mchis stabs/ deng skabs rgyal khab phyi nang kun tu tshan rig pa mkhas can dag gis phyogs yongs nas slob sbyong dang zhib 'jug gi gom stabs mgyogs len byed bzhin pa dang / rang re'i rgyal khab nas kyang tang gi mi rigs srid jus don 'khyol dang nub rgyud gsar spel byed pa'i 'gros dad bstun nas bod kyi gso ba rig pa'i las don nyid sgo kun nas nyams pa sor chud dang ma nyams gong spel gnang ste nyams dga'i yul khams shig tu bskyal yod/ 'on kyang phyi nang gi 'gal rkyen du ma'i dbang gis rang 1

re'i gso rig thad kyi gzhung man ngag gi gdams pa gang mang nyams nyes su gyur dang 'gyur mus yin pa'ang nga tshos mig mthong lag zin du 'khums shing /bod kyi gso rig 'di nyid gna' bo'i rig gnas shig yin pa'i ngos nas zhu na/ri rgyal lhun po'i gtos dang mnyam pa'i gzhung man ngag gi gsung rab de rnams sngar las lhag pa'i sgo nas sngog 'don myur skyob dang 'tshol sdud legs sgrig bcas byed rgyu ni thog mar bsgrub dgos pa'i rmang gzhi'i las ka gal chen zhig ste 'o skol tshe rig 'dzin pa rnams kyi phrag la rang bzhin gyis babs pa'i dus rabs kyi 'gan 'khri zhig lags/ de'i phyir nga tshos lo rgyus kyi las 'gan dang dus rabs kyi blang bya ltar mdo dbus mtho sgang zhes pa'i thun min khor yug khrod du 'phel rgyas byung ba'i gna' bo'i gso dpyad rig pa 'di'i srog dbugs rgyun bsrings byed cing / bod kyi gso dpyad nig par sbyang brtson dang zhib 'jug byed par spro ba brtas pa'i rnam dpyod can mang por rgyu cha mkho sprod kyi sgo 'phar yangs por phyes pa/ rang lugs kyi gzhung rkang 'dzin pa la sngar bas sman thogs thub pa/ nyam thag nad pa'i lus srog me gzir ba'i nad rigs rtsa med du 'joms par nus pa'i gzhung lugs kyi rgyab rten dang man ngag zab mo'i gdams pa chig thub kyi skor mang du btsal nas nad kyi sdug bsngal las skyob par rngo thogs pa bcas mdor na gangs can gso ba rig pa 'di nyid ming don mtshungs pa'i sgo nas rgyud 'dzin legs po zhig byed pa'i ched du/ nged cag mtsho sngon zhing chen bod kyi gso rig zhib 'jug khang gis 'brel yod ched mkhas mi sna rtsa 'dzu gas dang gso ba rig pa'i gna' dpe dag sgrig gi mi sna ched bskos byas te/ lo rgyus yig cha dang / gzhung lugs bstan bcos/ man ngag lag len/ sman spyor myong byang / sngo sman 'khrungs dpe/gnam rig skar rtsis sogs kyi dpe rgyun dkon po'i rigs gtso bor bzung thog 〈bod kyi gso ba rig pa'i gna' dpe phyogs bsgrigs dpe tshogs 〉zhes pa 2

'di rtsom sgrig byas pa yin zhing / dpe skrun thad dpe deb re re bzhin mdzad pa'i lo rgyus kyi snga phyi dang nang don la ma bltos par lag len du 'khyol gang thub byas te dpe rnying lag tu son no cog dag sgrig dang dpe skrun 'grems spel bya rgyu yin/de la bod kyi gso rig 'dzin skyong spel gsum gyi thad thugs khur tshad med gnang bzhin pa'i yul shul lho 'brong sprul bstan 'dzin nyi ma sogs kyis gnangs pa'i lag bris ma dag gzhir bzung nas bsgrigs pa'i 〈karma rat+na'i sman yig gces btus 〉zhes bya ba 'di ni dz+nyobod kyi gso ba rig pa'i gna' dpe phyogs bsgrigs dpe tshogs 〉zhes pa'i nang gses kyi deb re gcig pa yin la/ de la 〈〈gces bsdus 'chi med nor bu'i phreng ba 〉〉dang 〈〈'chi med nor phreng gi ma bu go bsgrigs 〉〉zhes pa gnyis kyi nang rgyun mthong dang rgyun 'byung gi nad gzhi khag cig la byang zur mkhas pa'i srol rgyun ji snyed yod pa'i nang nas nyer mkho'i nying bcud bsdus shing rang gi bla ma dam pa'i man ngag gis mdzes par brgyan nas nges pa chig chod kyi sman sbyor nyis brgya lhag gi sbyar thabs dang kha tshar/ sman rta/ phan nus sogs zhib par brjod yod la/〈〈'chi med nor phreng las man ngag snying gi nor bu 〉〉zhes pa'i nang gong ma gnyis las gsungs pa'i sman sbyor de dag gi sbyor tshad dang go dka'i gsang sman gyi brda sprod pa/ gzhan thang phye ril bu'i sbyor tshul dang khyad 'phags sman sbyor gang mang zhig gi nus bskyed kyi gzungs sngags sogs gsal bar bstan yod/ 〈〈'dod 'byung man ngag yon tan nor bu'i bang mdzod gsal byed phan bde'i sgo 'byed lde mig 〉〉ces pa'i nang man ngag yon tan rgyud kyi rtogs dka'i brda dang don rnams la rje zur mkhar dang dharma kirti/ 'gro phan dbang po sogs kyi len la gzhi bcol te tshig nyung zhingartso go bde ba'i ngang legs par bkrol yod/ gzhan sman gyi rkyang sel gyi skor 'ga' dang ming gcig la don 3

mang du dpyad rgyu yod pa dag yan lag brgyad pa dang gser mchan 'dod 'jo sogs snga phyi'i gzhung btsun rnams las tshur drengs te phyogs bsdus kyi tshul du bkod yod/ de yang dpe tshogs 'di nyid dag sgrig dang rtsom sgrig byed pa'i rtsa 'dzin 'di lta yin te/ 1 yi ge nor ba dang dogs gzhi can rnams la ming tshig gang de'i rjes su rtags(3'di'i nang dag bcos byas yod/ 2 gzhung tshig chad par 'dod pa rnams rtags ()'di'i nang du kho skong byas yod/ 2 rtsom pa po'i mchan rnams gzhung dngos kyi yig gzugs las chung tsam byas nas bkod yod/ 4 ma yigargomi gsal ba'am gzhung tshig chad pa rnams la kha skong byed ma nus pa rtags 'diso mtshon par byas yod la gug rtags 〈 〉'di'i nang du ma yig gi shog grangs sam thig phreng ci trem zhig chad yod pa gsal bshad byas yod/ 5 rgya tsha dang rgyam tsha sogs tshwa sna'i rigs rnams dag yig mkhas pa'i kha rgyan ltar te/ sog tsha dang rgya tsha zhes tshig grogs dang bsdeb na wa btags mi 'dogs shing / sog po'i tshwa dang rgya mtsho'i tshwa zhes pa'am tshwa ming rkyang pa'i skabs su wa btags 'dogs zhes pa ltar sbyar yod/lan tshwa zhes pyoni bod kyi gso ba rig pa'i dpe gzhung mang che ber bstun nas dmiges bsal du wa zur sbyar nas bkod yod/'dir nga tsho dag sgrig mi sna'i shes bya'i chu tshad dman zhing dpe rnying dag sgrig gi nyams myong zhan pa'i dbang gis ma rtogs 'gal 'khrulo gyi cha gang mang yodasrid pa la rgya che klog pa po rnams kyis dgongs 'char lhugs par gnang bar bka' drin che zhu'o//mtsho sngon zhing chen bod spyi gso rig zhib 'jug khang ras/〈bodakli gso ba rig pa'i gna' dpe phyogs bsgrigs dbe tshogs〉rtsom sgrig tshogs pa /spyi lo 2007lo'i zla 2pa'i tshes rdonyin/4

dkar chagartsom pa po ngo sprod mdor bsdus/ 1༄7/gso rig yan lag brgyad ldan chu gter las gces bsdus 'chi med nor bu'i phreng ba zhes bya ba bzhugs so//le'u dang po/ rlung nad sel ba'i sde tshan/ 3le'u gnyis pa/ mkhris nad sel ba'i sde tshan/ 8 le'u gsum pa/ bad kan 'dus nad sel ba'i sde tshan/ 10le'u bzhi pa/ gcong sde bzhi sel ba'i sde tshan/ 17le'u lnga pa/ 'khrugs rimarme gnyan tshad sel ba'i sde tsharne/ 22li'u drug pa/ gnyan nad sel ba'i sde tshan/ 29le'u bdun pa/ byang khog stod nad sel ba'i sde tshan/ 34le'u brgyad pa/ don snod kyi nad sel ba'i sde tshan/ d+ku 41le'u dgu pa/ srin nad sel’ba'i sde tshan/ 49le'u bcu pa/ 'bam dreg grum sogs chu ser gyi nad sel ba'i sde tshan/ 51le'u bcu gcig pa/ mo nad dang gza' gdon sel ba'i sde tshan/ 55le'u bcu gnyis pa/ mi dang rta bong kun gyi dug nad sel ba'i sde tshan/571

le'u bcu gsum pa/ rma nad sel ba'i sde tshan/ 59le'u bcu bzhi pa/ bshal lums byug pa bcas kyi sman sbyor dang lag len gyi sde tshan/ 62le'u bco lnga pa/ man ngag nyer mkho kha thor gyi sde tshan/ 67༄༅/gces bsdus 'chi med nor phreng las man ngag snying gi nor bu bzhugs so//mchod brjod/ ’ 83le'u dang po/ rlung gi sman sbyor bstan pa/ 83le'u gnyis pa/ mkhris pa'i sman sbyor bstan pa/ 86le'u gsum pa/ bad kan gyi sman sbyor bstan pa/ 86le'u bzhi pa/ gcong sde bzhi'i sman sbyor bstan pa/ 91le'u lnga pa/ tsha ba sel ba'i sman sbyor bstan pa/ 96le'u drug pa/ gnyan nad rigs kyi sman sbyor bstan pa/ 101le'u bdun pa/ mig nad sogs kyi sman sbyor bstan pa/ 105le'u brgyad pa/ don snod nad rigs kyi sman sbyor bstan pa/ 112le'u dgu pa/ srin nad sel ba'i sman sbyor bstan pa/ 116le'u bcu pa/ dreg dang grum bu'i rigs kyi sman sbyor bstan pa/ 118le'u bcu gcig pa/ mo nad dang gza' grib rigs kyi sman sbyor bstan pa/ 119le'u bcu gnyis pa/ dug nad rigs sel ba'i sman sbyor bstan pa/ 120le'u bcu gsum pa/ rma nad sel ba'i sman sbyor bstan pa/ 121le'u bcu bzhi pa/ rin chen gtsug bshal sogs kyi sman sbyor dang bzo 2

lugs bstan pa/ rī 123le'u bco lnga pa/ man ngag nyer mkho kha thor gyi sman sbyor bstan pa/ ji 128le'u bcu drug pa/ nyer mkho lag len 'ga' zhig bstan pa/ 134le'u bcu bdun pa/ sman byin rlabs pa'i phud mchod nyung bsdus bstan pa/ 145༄khya//byang zur mkhas pa'i mardzod 'ching gi man ngag gces dgu bsdus shing bla ma'i gsung rgyun gyis zur brgyan pa 'chi med nor 'phreng gi ma bu go bsgrigs pa bzhugs so//le'u dang po/ rlung nad sel ba'i sde tshan/ 151le'u gnyis pa/ mkhris nad sel ba'i sde tshan/ 154le'u gsum pa/ bad kan 'dus nad sel ba'i sde tshan/ 155le'u bzhi pa/ gcong nad sde bzhi sel ba'i sde tshan/ r+ṣa 157le'u lnga pa/ 'khrugs rims gnyan tshad sogs sel ba'i sde tshan/ 161le'u drug pa/ gnyan nad sel ba'i sde tshan/ 165le'u bdun pa/ byang khog stod nad sel ba'i sde tshan/ 166le'u brgyad pa/ don snod sel ba'i sde tshan/ 167le'u dgu pa/ glang thabs sogs srin nad thor bu srel ba'i sde tshan/ 168le'u bcu pa/ 'bam dreg grum sogs chu ser gyi nad sel ba'i sde tshan/170le'u bcu gcig pa/ kha thor gyi nad sel ba'i sde tshan/ 1723

18 ༄7/karma rat+na'i sman yig gces btus/pa dang // pho log pho ba spu byi dang // pho sul lcags kyi dregs (dreg3chags dang // pho ba dug thabs mchin nad dang // mchin pa skyes dang 'phyang ba dang // mchin chu skyugs shing sgrogs par bcas// rgyu gzer grol ma dug thabs rigs// 'dril bcas gru gur sgong ba sogs// mdor na pho log rgyu gcong la// sman sbyor 'di las lhag pa med// rno bas spu gris gcod dang mtshungs// sman nag thugs kyi dkyil du chongs//zhi byed drug pa'i sbyor ba ni// ma nu sga skya a ru lcum rtsa dang // cong zhi bul tog rim bzhin cha re bskyed// ma zhu dug dang pho sbos glang thabs dang //thur sel rlung log bu dang sha ma thog / bshang 'gags long srin sogs la phan zhes bshad// man ngag ldan na zhi drug la go thal lhum rtsa'i bong tshad sbyar ba man ngag gobadud rtsir mtshungs so brjod//oṃ a thā/ slob dpon pad+ma 'byung gnas kyis mdzad pa'i cong zhi dgu sgror gyi man ngag lha btsun byang chub 'od kyis gter nas bton/ 'gro mgon phag mo gru (grub3pas phyag len gtan 'bebs mdzad pa ni/ gzhi ma cong zhi phul gang nas 'bru gsum rim par tshos ring brngo/ de nas dkyil kyong tsam byas par chang phul gsum tsam blug phral kha brgyab nas rlangs pa mi 'chor ba dgos bzang bo la// dug gi kha 'dzin a ru ra// mchin pa'i kha 'dzin gur kum dang // shing tsha mkhal ma'i kha 'dzin ni// sug smel pho bar se 'bru btang // grang ba'i kha 'dzin pi pho gnyis// ma zhur rgyam tsha rlung khrag la// sga skya ru rta tshad bzhin sbyar// tsha grang rta yis bsgyur te phul// pho nad lhon bad kan be snabs gsog pa la lhon zhes bshad ces so skran ma zhu dang // bad kan skya smrag sbos 'dril skyugs// mdor na tsha rims gsar ma gtogs// ma lus ba mor nyi phog bzhin// stobs 'phel mdangs rgyas bcud len 'gyur// myos byed chang gi gnyen po'ang lags//gur kum tig ta gser me tog / ru rta brag zhun a ru ra// hong len se

༄7gces bsdus 'chi med nor bu'i phreng ba/ 19'bru sbyar ba'i phyer// phag ril bsnan pas mkhris skran 'joms// rgod btu la mgron thal tsha skran 'joms// star bu mdze tshas khrag skran bshig / skran 'joms zla bsil zhes su grags//rgyud du/ tsha (tshwa3bsreg ze cha go thal sbyor ba yang // man ngag ldan na skran bshig sman mchog go/grang skran la/ se 'bru cong zhi rgod btul rdo zhun pi ling bcas bsnan par lhan thabs gsungs/ tsha (tshwa3bsregs smyor ba ba tsha med pa'i tshwa// sngo zhing ro mngar ldan pa khyor ba do//ba zho bre gang rgod sha byang lugs bya rgod/ zur lugs g.yag rgod kyi sha yin par bzhed mtheb tsam sbyar// btsos dkrugs chu chod phrul por song ba dang // rdzar blugs du ba ma 'chor kha bcad la// bong mes tshos par bsregs pa'i thal ba de// star bu zho gsum pi pi ling dang bu ram sbyar// mtshur gnyis zho bdun/ rgod btul zho drug mgron thal zho lnga/ byang bul zho bzhi/ ze tsha zho gnyis/ a ru ra zho gang bsnan pa lhan thabs lugs/ mazhu lhon dang lcags dreg khrag skran bshig /cong zhi 'phrul thal/ gzhung du a ru gser mdog tsha la dang // rgyam tsha bong dkar pi pi ling // 'di rnams zho re'i ljid dang mnyam// mu zi btul ma zho yi phyed// pho cong bzang bo zho bcu btang // 'di rnams phye mar 'thags la zhe ga'i (zhig ka'i3kong bu sogs gzhung bzhin bsregs pa'i thal ba de nyid cha gcig ka ra sum 'gyur byas la thun chen chu tshan gyis phul/ phye (ma ) ril (bu )gang yang rung la// ma zhu lhon dang lcags dreg dang // pho ba'i me mnyam rdo dug dang // bad mkhris skya smug skran gyi rigs// mchin pa'i khrag skran rnying pa dang // pho nad tsha grang med par 'joms//shing mngar 'u su lcam pa dang // srad dkar skyu ru glang sna drug / 'di la a bhi drug spyor zer// tsha chu'i rtsa lam 'byed pa'i mchog /skya rbab nad la lcags phye bco lnga ni// gtso bo lcags phye thun gnyis tshad ldan sbyar// lcags phye 'bras bu tsha chu la cha bskyed gsum dang tsha ba gsum grang chu la cha

20 ༄7karma rat+na'i sman yig gces btus/bskyed/ / da li (lis3shing tsha se 'bru sug smel dang // gser bye sdig srin gze ma lcam pa rnams skya rbab dang 'or la 'di bzhi phri/ / tsha chu shas che 'bras gsum gze lcam bskyed// grang chu che na tsha ba gsum po bskyed// chu sman gzhir bzhag bzhi char mnyam par gces// skya rbab 'or gyi dus su chu sman dbri// chu yod 'dren cing med na skom par byed// zangs thal nyi shu'i sbyor ba ni// zangs thal lcags thal chu ser sman gsum dang // 'u su skyu ru lcam pa pi pi ling // cu gang gur kum ru rta ba sha ka/a ru gser mdog gi waṃ ut+pal dang // se 'bru tsan+da tutsan dan1dkar bo sgron shing dang // nā ga ge sar da li (lis3seng ldeng rnams// zhib btags ka ra dkar po bzhi 'gyur sbyar// chu bskol phul la srod la btang bar bya// glo nad gsar rnying dreg grum chu ser mdze// khyad par dmu 'or skya rbab nad la bsngags// gdams pa 'di ni dwags po sman pa'i lugs//bde byed chu bsgrur chung 'bring che// dang po cu gang bdun bsil gsum ut+pal se 'bru pi pi ling // shing tsha ka ra bzhi 'gyur cu gang bdunaspyo tsha grang cha snyoms dang ga 'byed par byed pa'i steng // de dang bungs mnyam am bha (bhi3skyu ru ra sbyar// chung ngu 'o de steng gser bye dang // klu glang dkar po sdug srin nyi dga' ba lcam pa/ / kun dga' gzhon nu 'usushing mngar dang // gze ma dang ni de kun dang // bungs mnyam am bha tubhi3'bring po yin// chen po de steng dung 'dra 'bu skyogs dang //'khor srad dkar bung (bungs1mnyam bsgyur bsnan mnyam am bha (bhi1sbyar// phye ma 'u skyur lha mo yi// thang gis phul btang tsha grang snyoms// rtsa sbubs 'gags sbyong byer zags dang // ldan 'dus la sogs chu rigs kun// gsang ba'i lam du 'dren pa'i mchog/da li (lis3bcu drug sbyor ba ni// se 'bru shing tsha pi pi ling // sug smel gur kum rnam pa lngas// lus spyi 'du ba snyoms par byed// sha pho ru rta li

༄7gces bsdus 'chi med nor bu'i phreng ba/ 21shi dang // ar nag dzā ti snying zho shas// thor bu'i rlungu rnams sel bar byed//rgun 'brum cu gang shing mngar dang // ga dur glo ba'i nad rnams sel// da li (lis3sdig srin sbyar ba yis// chu ser skya rbab nad rigs 'joms// sbrang dang bur dkar gtar (rtar3skyon pa// sman nus myur du 'byin par byed//kun gyi phan yon bstan pa ni// ma zhu glang thabs pho sbos dang // tsha grang 'thab pa'i nad rnams dang // stod 'tshangs bad rlung mgo 'khor dang // glo lu skad 'gags lus po skrangs// skya rbab sa chu ma thub la// sleb pas chog pa kho bos mthong //se 'bru bzhi steng gur kum gser bye dang // sdig srin 'u su lcam pa'i 'bras bu bsnan// skyu ru ra ni kun dang 'go snyoms sbyar// chu rigs bco lnga 'dren cing skem par byed// dwangs ma chu 'dren zhes bya'i gdams ngag go /ḍā ka'i gsung las 'ong ba'i gsang ba'i sman// chu ma rtsi srang gang zho bdun dang srad nag zho bzhi skar bzhi prayang ku zho bzhi skar bzhi/ / glangasna zho bzhi skar gang srad dkar zho bzhi skar gang ut+palazho bzhi skar gang nyidaga'i 'bru zho lnga skar gang / / gur kum zho bzhi skar gang skyuruzho gsum sdig srin zho lnga skar gang gser gyi bye zholnga/ / gze ma zho gsum 'bu skyogs zhobazhi se 'bru zho lngadang // pi ling zholnga'ajam 'bras zhobazhisug sbel zho gsum lcags phye dang cu gang zho bzhi shing mngar zhogasum sro lo dkar po'i zho bzhi steng // gsang sman sngo spyi bzhur zho gsum tsha grang sngon mo chab 'dren gnyis dang 'bring po sgatigazho lnga bcas// tsha grang rang rang gtsor smos skabs brtsis pa'i//khyad par chu sman chu rtsi nyer lnga 'dis// tsha grang ldan sogs chu nad gang yin kyang // them bral rdza ma'i chu la 'dren pa bzhin// rim par gsang ba'i lam nas 'dren par nges//phye ma gur kum zho gang skar lnga dang ni pri yang ku zho gang skar drug pri yang ku'i me tog ma shar pa gong ltar dus thus(btus3/ / ut+pal skar gsum gseragyi me tog skar brgyad

22 ༄7/karma rat+na'i sman yig gces btus/bong nga dkar zho gang skar bzhi/ / bsha ka zho gang skar lnga dang skyu ru ra zho gang skar do sbyar ba// gur kum bdun nam 'bol sman bdun pa ste// chu mdog ljang na pi ling agar bsnan// ser na kyi lce dug nyung dkar po la// ru rta ba lu sha lpags tupags3bar gyi chur| nyi dga' 'u su bsnan pa chu bskol gyis// 'phul lam yang na gong bshad thang gis phul// tsha chu'i nad rtags che na a cang che tsha shas che tsam la yang yun ring bsten// de yis dri chu'i bung kyibungasakache pho ba bde// tsha ba'i chu de ldan nam grang churatshobasgyur// ma 'gyur srid kyang tsha chu'i rlabs 'dis gcog / ldan nam grang chu la'ang zhag 'ga' bar// thog ma sman 'di gtong ba myong ba'i gnad//yang can byang rtsi'i dar sman ni// zho dang 'o ma cha mnyam pa// grang dro ran par dkrogs byas la// de yisne dar ba ras su bcug / 'bol sman bdun dang li shi dang // gsang ba'i gser bye sdig srin lcam 'bru smanagasum srad dkar byi ru'i phreng ldan rkyal ba chu thub zhib par btags// dar bar btab la zhag gsum byibs//de nas sun (thun3 chung yang yang bsten// dmu chu rang dbang med par 'dren//le'u lnga pa/ 'khrugs rims gnyan tshad sel ba'i sde tshan/'bras bu gsum dang ma nu bzhi thang bsdebs// gdus grang btang bas rlung khrag 'khrugs gsum la// chu dwangs nor bu chu steng bzhag pa bzhin// de rnams rang bzhin ma lus dwangs par 'gyur// des na 'di la nor bu chu dwangs zer// 'bras bu gsum steng ba le ba sha ka / sle tres tig ta hong len bong nga dkar// ga dur 'di rnams thang chen bcu pa zhes// rnyings pa'i tshad pa rol

༄7/gces bsdus 'chi med nor bu'i phreng ba/ 23du gsod pa'i mchog /'bras gsum gla sgang byi tsher dang // gu gul stag sha par+ya ta// thang chen brgyad po bskol grang btang // gnyan tshad gzer thung 'joms pa'i mabyebyeg /'phrul thang bcu gnyis pa yi sbyor ba ni// bdun thang steng du bong dkar kyi lce dkar// spang rtsi hong len sro lo dkar po rnams// bsnan pa ma smin rims 'khrugs dar ( dkargan gyi// nad zungs ngan la mchog tu bsngags pa yin//gung pa'i spra thang khyad 'phags bzhugs// sngo yi rgyal po gnyan 'dul ba bdud rtsi gangs shams pa/ / ma gi ta gla rtsi dang sbur dug stag sha sera.a ru ra / / ra rlon bongang g.yul ngor dar thod can tsherasngon/ / kha srung cu gur gi gsum brgyab//stobs can zungs bzang phal cher la// sngo bzhi tig ta hong len ba sha ka bong dkar dag kyang bsdebs pa'o// thang phye gang yang rung ba yi// phye ma bskol grangs dag gis phul// rgya nad 'dzum bu ltag dgyed dang // 'jang gi sha ser sha (k+ṣa1ya dang // bod kyi bdun drug nywa gas dang // rgyu gzer gnyan gzer tshad rgyas dang // 'khrugs tshad rims tshad thams cad la// bdud rtsi nyid dang gnyis su med//rje'u gtso bo brgyad kyi spyor ba ni// bsil gyi gtso bo gi waṃ tsan dan dkar// rtsi yi gtso bo cu gang gur kum gnyis// thang gi gtso bo tig ta ba sha ka / sngo yi gtso bo hong len bong nga dkar// ka ra dkar po bzhi 'gyur rta la bskyon// don snod glo mchin khrag mkhris 'khrugs rims kyi// tshad pa gsar rnying ma lus 'joms par nges// gtso brgyad la stag sha gtso bor bsnan pa ni g.yu ral can te rims tshad sogs gnyan la mchog gtso bo brgyad dang nor bu chu dwangs bsres//sprin bral zla zer tshad rnying ldan tshad sel// gtso brgyad steng du khyung lnga

24 ༄7/karma rat+na'i sman yig gces btus/ —bsdebs// gtso khyung zhes byas gnyan tshad 'joms//spang rtsi do bo phur mang (mong3 dang // stag sha bong dkar tsan dan gnyis// re skon gu gul brag gi zhun// cu gang gla rtsi 'dzin pa rnams// cha mnyam zhib btags bsten pa yis// rgyu gzer 'brum rigs khrag mkhris tshad//rgyas tshad rnyings tshad gag lhog dang // rims tshad gzer thung sel ba'i mchog / 'chi gsos be do bcu gsum mo//gzhan yang spang rtsi bong dkar stag sha dang // par pa ta dang bdud rtsi lo ma mnyam// cu gang gur kum gi waṃ tsan dan dkar// brag zhun gla rtsi gu gul nag po sbyar// stod lugs spang rtsi bcu gnyis khyad chos can// gnyan tshad ma lus gsod par byed pa'i mchog/ rims nad stobs chen 'joms pa'i gnyen po yin//sngo rgod bdud rtsi'i rgya mcho'i sbyor ba ni// stong ri zil ba chab tuchar3gyi nang du skye// gang gā chung ni g.ya' dang spang la skye// lcags tig ra mgo na ba'i nang la skye// 'dzin pa zhes bya rgya shod gang yang skye// bzhi ka cha mnyam gla ba zhad tsam bsdebs// gnyan tshad thog babs nad la bsngags pa yin//ga bur nyi shu rtsa lnga'i sbyor ba ni// ga bur bzang po drug dang a ga ru//tsan dan dkar dmar ut+pal ge sar gnyis// ru rta zi ra dkar po ba le ka/shing tsha chu srin sder mo na gi ste ma rnyed na sngos kyang tshab rung pu shel rtse// spang spos rdo dreg dmar po 'bu su hang // tsha grang 'bras bu gsum dang tsha ba gsum// kha bsgyur ka ra dkar po drug 'gyur sbyar// don snod sha lpags spyopags3rtsa rus tshad pa dang // 'grams 'khrugs rim (rims3dug tshad pa gsar rnying dang //dreg grum me dbal byang khog thig (thigs3zags rnag / lus la gnas pa'i tshad pa ma lus 'arjoms// khyad par tshad rnying byer ba gting nas 'don//oṃ a tha/ bsil sbyor sngo yi rgyal po g.ya' kyi ma// gtso bo yin pas kun

༄7gces bsdus 'chi med nor bu'i phreng ba/ 29bo lnga 'gyur zhib btags la// lo brgyad dri chus ril bu dril// stod du bab (babasakapa'i gzer thung dang // bar du bab (babs3pa'i rgyu gzer dang //smad du bab (babs3pa'i nywa gas dang // gag pa dang ni lhog pa dang // khyad par nag po sum sgril dang // mkhris pa rtsar rgyug nad la bsngags// bzhi brgya rtsa bzhi'i nad rnams la// 'di yis mi 'joms gang yang med// rma gsar sbrum ma dag la spang //le'u drug pa/ gnyan nad sel ba'i sde tshan/gnyan nad gso ba'i sde tshan la// man ngag spyi 'joms rdo rje can 'di'i rtsa ba'i sman sna bcu po 'di rtsa chu 'gags pa la khyad thon yin par lhan thabs su gsungs/ / gtso bo rgya tsha 'dzin pa gnyis thun gcig/ shug tsher re ral spang spos gzer 'joms bzhi// thun re gla rtsi gi wang dom mkhris rnams// thun gcig so sor zhib btags gcig tu bsre// lo brgyad chus sbru 'dam btags ril bu dril//mtshal gos bskon te rten 'brel snying bo brjod// kha bsgyur tsha ba gsum dang sbyar// grang ba 'joms shing bad kan sel// gur kum tsan+dan chu dang sbyar//tshad pa 'joms shing mkhris pa sel// gu gul gla rtsi'i chu dang sbyar// lhog dmar 'joms shing srin bu 'dul// thal sman mi rta khyi'i thod rus nus bsreg gsum dang sbyar la btang // skran rnams 'joms shing 'bras rigs bsregs// cu gang chu rtsa yung ba'i chu dang sbyar// chu ser 'dren zhing khrag rul 'khru// byi tang ma ru lang thang rtse// glang srin gsod cing mgo srin 'joms// bzang bo drug dang sbyar la btang // nad rigs gang la'ang bdud rtsi 'dra// thar nu re lcag lcum rtsa sbyar// gag lhog gzer gyi nad rnams 'ded// rno gsum rgya tsha/ sdig srin/byang ba shrī khaṇ+ḍa sbyar// rtsa 'gags 'ded cing chu 'gags sel// ma nu sle tres

༄7gces bsdus 'chi med nor bu'i phreng ba/ 31tang ka / sman chen rnams ni zho re re// sbyor ba rnam rgyal dgu pa dang // ser po rta bdud nyid kyang tshang // 'dis ni gag lhog 'khyams po dang // log khreb khong shor skyi chu 'thabs thab 'thor pa/ / ya ma kha med gnyan dang ni// lce 'bam 'joms shing khyad par du// sman btang gnyid log rnag tu khug/yang zab khyad par bi ṣa nag po dang // gla rtsi ru rta shu dag a ru ra//snying khrag rus pa rgyus pa sha dang lnga// tshad dang sbyar te dri chus ril bu dril//bya khyung rnam pa lnga yi ril bu 'di// srod dus lnga bdun dgu rnams rim pas btang // pho log srin nad gnyan gzer gag lhog dang // khyad par chu ser mdze nad 'joms pa'i mchog/ yang rgyud las/ rin chen sbyor ba dngul chu dug phral dang // mu zi seng ldeng khaṇ+ḍa bzang po drug/ chu ser sman gsum gu gul bya khyung sbyar// zhes gsungs pa la slob dpon chen po pad+ma saṃ bha was// chu sman ral gri khyung gi mchu//so ra thal rdor rwa g.yas g.yon// seng ldeng spos dkar sder mo la// bzang po drug gi gshog sgrog ste// sa bcud 'dre 'jigs spyan mig go / yongs rdzogs dngulatsheng me dbal can// zhes gsungs pas rdo gtun 'jam po me'am nyi mar lag pas tshugs tshad du bsros pa'i nang du mu zi zho gang blugs pa legs par mnyes nas byang ba dang / de'i khar dngul chu zho gang blug te sbyong bas nam mkha'i mdog ltar gyur ba de khyung lnga smug po'i dus su bsnan la sbyar/bzang drug thun bzang ba re re chu ser sman gsum dang seng ldeng khaṇ+ḍa thun tshad re re 'am/ yang na kho ba'i bla ma'i bka' mchan du dngul chu btso bkru ma byas pa zho gang gi bzhi nam/ star bu zho phyed kyis bshigs pa mu zi seng ldeng khaṇ+ḍa bzhi nam re/ chu ser sman gsum thun re zhes byung ba shin tu 'jam par mngon la/ de gnyis gang ltar byed kyang rtsi bzhin btags pa de nag po'i dus su bsnan la sbyar/ dngul chu sbyar nas nyi ma'am mes drod ma yal bar du

32 ༄7/karma rat+na'i sman yig gces btus/'thag pa dang / gar song nas dri chu bran te sna ma chad pa dang / dgongs mo 'jog khar khebs legs shing dgun yin na mi 'khyags pa gal che'o// zhes bshad pa ltar nyams su blang bar bya'o// 'di yi phan yon ni gzhung du/ klu yi gdon 'joms chu ser rtsad nas skems// zhes dang / slob dpon pad+mas/gnyan lhog sa gdon zas su za// gza' dang sde brgyad ar la gtod// bzhi brgya rtsa bzhi'i g.yul ngo bzlog/ ces dang / rje zur mkhar pas 'di la khyung rgod drag po me dbal can zhes bya ste/ dug ma gtogs nad thams cad kyi gnyen po bla na med pa'i man ngag snying thig ma'o// zhes gsungs/ mnyam spyor khyung rgyod drag po la// sa bcud rtsi chen gshog sgro rgyas// 'dre 'jigs rgya yi spyan mig dod// rang lus nam mkha' yangs pa la// nyi zla zung 'jug ltar 'khor nas// ya nga'i mun pa kun srung byed// ces gsungs pa'i mu zi ser po shing kun gu gul rgya tsha rnams bzhi nam re bsnan la/ ril bu sran ma tsam dril te rab gnas byas spar (par3bur bcug ste lus la bcang nas zhog (zhogs3pa lto stong la ril bu re re ma chag par zos na 'go ba'i nad thams cad bsrung ba bla na med pa'o//ga bur mchu la dngul chu sder// bzang po drug gi gshog sgro la// gi wang dang ni ldong ros rwa// a byag stag sha sbyan mig ste// 'di ni zla 'od nor bu'i khyung / / gnyan rims tshad gzer tsha chu skran// srin dang ya ma pho glang 'bras//gza' mdze chu ser ma lus 'joms// zhes pa'i sbyor ba 'di yang snga ma ltar tshul bzhin du sbyar bas nad rigs mtha' dag rang gnas su 'joms par byed pa'o//dngul chung sgrul mig spyor ba ni// gtso bo dngul chu btul ma la//bzang drug chu ser sman gsum dang // zi ra dkar nag gza' dug pa// seng ldeng thal ba rma bya'i gzhob// mu zi rdo rgyus bya bal ma// rdo rgyal sbal rgyab/ mdung

44 ༄7ོ/karma rat+na'i sman yig gces btus/shing mngar spos dkar rgun 'brum gsum// skyu ru cu gang 'bri mog gsum//hong len ug chos dmar po rnams// rim pa bzhin du legs bsdebs pa//glo ba'i nad la thengs pas chog/ glo 'khrugs glo tshad byer rgyas dang // glo ba gor ral rigs rnams dang // smug po glo byed zagatshobyed la// bdud rtsi lta bur phan pa yin//rgyud chen gur kum bdun gur kum cu gang ut+pal ba sha ka/ sum tig a ru shug tsher ka ra sbyar/ gur kum mchog bdun mchin nad gsar rnying dang / mchin pa bsnad 'grams khrag rgyas mig ser sel//steng ba cile ka/ ma nu hong len skyu ru gangs kyi thig tuthigs3/mtshal dkar sum cu tig dang se rgod 'bras// zhib btags ka ra sbyar ba bskol grang phul// byang lugs gur kum bco lnga'i sbyor ba 'dis// mchin nad tsha ba'i nad rigs bcu dang gsum// ma lus sel ba'i sbyor ba mchog tu bsngags// gur kum li shi gi wang bse ru mtshal// tsan dan gla rtsi 'jam 'bras bong nga dkar// ru rta 'bras bu gsum po sbyar ba'i phye// gur kum bcu gsum mchin rgud sbyar dug dang // mkhal ma snad 'grams chu sri tsha sbos dang // ya ma nag po'i srin nad sel bar byed// ko la bcu dgu/ sman mchog ka ko la dang cu gang dang // ba sha ka dang gur tig gser me tog/ nā ga ge sar a ru 'om bu dang // rgya skyegs ri tshos sug smel ru rta dang // bong dkar bre ga brag zhun 'jam 'bras dang // skyu ru spang spos zhib btags bskol grang phul// mtsher nad tsha grang med pa sel ba'i mchog/ mi yi dbang bo rnam rgyal grags bzang lugs//pho nad tsha grang ma lus pa// spyo 'joms bde ba'i myu gu ni// a ru gser mdog brag zhun mnyam// de gnyis dang ni star zhun mnyam// pi ling gur kum ut+pal// se sug skyu ru ba sha ka/ ru rta rgya tsha ma nu dang // cong zhi lcags

༄7gces bsdus 'chi med nor bu'i phreng ba/ 45phye puṣ+ṭha la// sbrul gyi sha rnams thun bzang re// ril bu sran tshad chu bskol phul// khrag mkhris pho bar lhung ba dang // srug po'i khrag skran 'dril ba dang //me nyams ma zhu gsar rnying sogs// pho nad tsha grang mtha' dag sel//brag zhun gla rtsi gur kum sug smel dang // dom mkhris bong nga pri ku a ru ra// ga dur sman chen ru rta shu dag nag/ ga bur nag po'i sbyor ba bcas pa 'di// brag khyung zhes grags snod kyi khrag mkhris dang // pho log gnyan srin gzer rigs gang yin rung // pho bar babs pa'i bdud rtsir 'gyur ba yin|mkhal ma'i nad la go yu dgu spyor bshad// gtso bo mkhal ma go yu dmar pobazang po gcig/ zho sha mkhal zho dkar po brag zhun gla rtsi 'bras sna gsum//sug smel bre ga nam re go yu'i bzhi cha gcig thun re waṃ pod lugs bu ram sbyar//mkhal ma'i nad sel nyams stobs rgyas byed la// tshad pa'i stobs ldan gur kum shug tsher bsnan// ka ra sbyar phye tshos gsum thang gis dbul// zla ba'i stobs ldan tsha gdung duḥkha rnams// bsil dang bde ba bskyed pa'i dpal 'byor thob// grang bas nyen bcas duḥkhar gyur pa na// tsha ba tshwa sna gsum dang bur dkar sbyar// a rag gar chang phul btang nyi ma yi// dkyil 'khor rgyas pas me drod bskyed pa ltar// zung (zungs3bdun dpal 'byor rgyas pa'i dga' ba thob// chu sri rgya tsha sdig srin gser bye bsnan// lcam 'bru'i thang gis phul bas dgos dgu 'grub//gur kum dom mkhris gangs kyi karka ṭa// rtsi bcud ril bu btsag chod mar gyis phul// tho rangs btang bas 'dzag pa khong nas sdom// nyams chung sa bon 'dod la bdud rtsir 'gyur//a ru ra dang gur kum sug smel dang // brag zhun tig ta mkhal ma zho sha dang // seng phrom btsod dang rgya skyeg shug tsher can// ka ra sbyar ba'i a ru bcu zhes bya// mkhal ma bsnad 'gram ('grams3 chu sri rked pa 'khor//

46 ༄7/karma rat+na'i sman yig gces btus/bshal 'phyes mkhal tshad ma lus sel bar byed//a ru nyer lnga/ yang na a ru bcu pa'i steng nyid du// rtsa ba lnga dang ba ru skyu ru ra// smad 'bras gsum dang bre ga go yu dang // gla rtsi nyi dga' gser bye nyer lnga 'dis// mkhal gcong mkhal ma'i nad rigs dang // mkhal 'grams byer rgyas lhung ba sel// khu tshur 'bum gyi yang snying yin//gtso bo a ru bcu pa'i steng nyid du// 'bras sna gsum dang gser phye ka ka ru sdigasrin/ / a rdza ka nyi dga' dang gla rtsi sman chen rnams// sbyar ba a ru bco brgyad pa zhes bya// phan yon mkhal rtsa 'gram ('grams3 byer dang // tsha 'gram ('grams3grang ba smad byer dang // khrag tshab (tshabs3rked pa 'khor ba dang // sprug po mkhal mar bab (babs3pa dang // chu ser grum bu'i nad rnams kun// sel byed 'di ni drang srong lugs//ar khyung / ar bcu khyung lnga cha mnyam gnyan 'grams dang // mkhal nad phal cher phan pa mkhas 'gas bzhed//se 'bru lnga steng bre ga pri yang ku// 'u su hong len brag zhun ba sha ka/tig ta spang rtsi gur kum skyu ru ra// sdig srin 'bu su ka ra'i rta la bskyon// se 'dru'i spyor ba bde byed kun phan zhes// gzhan la med pa'i khyad chos dam pa 'dis// me drod stobs 'phel zas len shed che zhing // ma zhu'i nad dang sha pags sbos pa dang // byer chu zags chu la sogs chu 'gags dang // chu skun la sogs skran gyi nad rnams kun// sel zhing mkhal rlung mkhal gcong nad la bsngags smug po rgyas la ru rta/ byer na phag khrag 'gying na cong zhi/ khrag la star bu bsdeb pa'ang yod/ /se 'bru lca ba sug smel nyi dga' ba// shing tsha nye shing ba spru pi pi ling //gze ma gur kum sbrang gi rta la skyon// gso byed nyi ma'i dkyil 'khor zhes bya 'di// phul byed chu bskol tshan mo skabs 'gar chang // ma zhu skran dang skya rbab

༄cugaces bsdus 'chi med nor bu'i phreng ba/ 47'or dmu chu// mkhal ma'i drod shor sa bon nyams 'dzag dang // chu sri mkhal rked rkang (lgang3ba chu sor zug/ tsha 'khru grang 'khru grang rnyogs grang srin dang //chu ser grang bab grang ba'i grum bu sogs// grang nad kun la dus mtha'i me lta bu// khyad par pho ba'i me drod bskyed pa'i mchog/ dwangs ma gnas 'jog chu ser tsha ba skem// lus zung (zungs3brtas byed tshe ring bcud len 'gyur//se 'bru lnga dang tsha ba sga pi pho gsum dang de steng dbyi mong dang tsi tra ka bcas lnga//khyung lnga mnyam spyor grang gnyan phan//ro rkyang las bab ( babs3 byang sems dkar dmar gnyis// nyes gsum duḥkhas thur du babs pa na// nyi zla gyen du bzlog pa'i gdams pa bshad// ba sha ka tigata hong len bong dkar tsan dmar khrag 'khrugs sel// se 'bru sug smel smad kyi grang ba sel// gur kum dom mkhris yung bas rtsa kha bsdams// rgya shug btsod kyis mkhal rtsa 'gram ('grams3byer sel// puṣ+ṭha ra ser lug ru ser po kun dang mgo mnyam sbyar// zhib btags dmar gsum gdus pa'i thang gis phul// phan yon zab khyad lag tu longs dang gsal//gtso bo bya khyung lnga pa'i lus po la// mdog ldan nya phyis gu gul mchu ru bskyon// zhu mkhan tshos btsod gshog sgro rgyas pa la// gur kum dom mkhris rgya snag mjug ma btags// mtshal dang sug smel mkhal zho'i sder ldan 'di//sā ra'i khyung lnga 'dzag sdom zhes bya ste// phal cher chu bskol grang rlung myos khus phul// mkhal ma'i tsha grang nad rigs yin cog dang // srin glang la sogs gnyan rigs kun bsngags shing // khyad par sa bon 'dzag pa gcod pa ste//sman nad thon nges lan 'ga' bsten pa yis// dwangs ma 'dzag gcod min kyang nad zug gcog/dngul chu nyen lnga'i sbyor ba ni// gtso bo dngul chu dul ma la// bzang drug gu gul shu dag dang // gla rtsi stag sha mu zi ser// chu ser sman gsum

48 ༄7/karma rat+na'i sman yig gces btus/gser bye dang // mkhal ma zho sha 'bras sna gsum// gadha pa tra basprushing kun dang // rgya tsha ru rta brag zhun rnams// ka ra sbyar ba'i ril bu dril// sle tres seng ldeng khu bas phul// phan yon gza' mdze skran dmu chu// gag lhog chu ser lpags (pags3nad 'dzer// ya ma dreg grum rkang 'bam sogs// khyad par mkhal grum nad la mchog/khyung dmar rdo rje gur chen zhes// bya chen khyung gi lus po la// mtshal dkar guragum nya phyis dom mkhris gshog sgro rgyas// dmar gsum 'dre 'jigs sder mo can// 'byung 'phrog jag pa'i dpung steng du// rdo rje pha lam lta bur 'joms//'bras bu gsum dang 'bras sna gsum// tsha ba pi ling tshwargya tsha snazhoshadakar podagu// srin gyi sman gla rtsi/ sdig srin/ dres 'bru gsum bu ram ril bu dril//mkhal ma'i grang srin thig le gcod// de steng rtsa ba dbang lag lnga bsnan mchog/srog rdel bcu gsum zhes su bshad// zhib par lag len snying nor ltos//rtsa thag bcu drug man ngag zab par bshad// rtsa thag 'bras bu dres 'bru yin snyam thang phrom 'bras bu dang // sug smel sdig srin bzhi po gtso bo la// bre ga smad 'bras gsum dang dmar po gsum// shug tsher a ru gser mdog gser me tog/ mkhal zho ba sha ka rnams chang sbyar btang // rlig pa skrangs pa rang zhi dag la 'gro// smad nad mkhal rtsa 'gram tu'agrams3dang mkhal rlung gcong // ma lus sel byed gdams ngag snying nor ro//dzā dngul sgror ba/ shin tu gsang pa'i sman mchog ni// bug pa med pa'i dzā ti gcig/ khog pa brus la de nang du// mu zi gser 'dra zho drug dang // dngul chu zho bzhi'i steng du ni// dzā ti'i phye ma gang shong blug/ de nyid thang khrom tuphrom1'bras bu'i phye// 'dam 'thag byas pas legs par dril// de yang bag zan sla mos dril// mar nag khol ma'i nang du btsos// bag zan nag

༄7gces bsdus 'chi med nor bu'i phreng ba/ 49por song ba la// mar nag khol thag chod pa'i tshe// dzā ti dngul chu mu zi gsum// 'dam btags legs par byas pa la// la la phud dang ka ko la//sug smel zi ra dkar nag gnyis// bre ga ze tsha kha ru tsha// sbyar ba 'dam btags bu ram gyis// ril bu sran ma tsam du dril// lnga lnga gar chang bzang po 'am// a rag gis phul ngo mtshar sman// gcin 'gags nad sel gze ma dang // lcam pa g.yer ma skyu ru ra// rgya tsha sdig srin thang gis phul// myong grub gdams pa zab mo'o//le'u dgu pa/ srin nad sel ba'i sde tshan/khong lhog gnyan tuganyen3po rgyal blon bcu bdun ni// rgyal blon bcu bdun ni/ rgyal po thang phrom dkar po rtsa ba 'bras bu gang rigs chig thub dpa' bo zho gang la// blon po ma gi glartsizho phyed zhal kha bsgyur// dmag mi sa bcud pho mo dngul chu mu zi btul ma dwa ba dang // shu dag 'dzim pa gu gul spru ma nag/ byi tang ma ru sgog skya lang thang rtse// rtsi chen shing kun g.yer ma dres ma'i 'bras bu rnams//thun phran re re'i cha mnyam zhib btags la// rdo yi dwangs ma rgyatsharno ba'i mtshon cha bskur// nag gsum mi rta khyi gsum gyi brun phur mang khu ba gdus pas phul// thun tshad nad stobs sbyar bas gnyan srin 'joms// sa steng 'di na gnyan dang srin gyi nad// sbyor ba 'di yis mi 'joms yod mi srid// 'di med khong lhog gso 'dod sman pa rnams// dpa' bo mtshon med g.yul ngor 'jug pa 'dra// des na 'di la shin tu gces par zungs//phan pa kun ldan dhisbyor ba glang thabs ni// rtsa ba thang phrom dkar po ril ma tsam// 'bras bu btang na nyi shu gcig/ se 'bru sug smel rgya tsha dang // gla rtsi shing kun byi tang ka/ g.ya' kyi ma nu sha pho ru// kha che gur gum pho ba ris//

50 ༄7/karma rat+na'i sman yig gces btus/sdig srin rgyam tsha a ru ra/ bong dkar thar nu dur byid rnams// zhib btags bur dkar ril bu ni// che chung bra ba'i ril ma tsam// gsum lnga bdun dgu bcu gcig sogs// na tshod nad stobs sbyar la gtong // mchin mtsher las byung don glang dang // pho long rgyu ma'i snod glang dang // gnyan glang dang ni srin glang dang // phyi nang rtsa yi glang thabs sogs// kun la lto ru dros tsam gyis// zug gzer gcog par the tshom med// za zi chal chol skyon yod na//mar gsar sdor ldan thug pa btang //dpa' bo bcu gnyis/ bya phur sleb mgyogs pa'i rta pho la// hong len 'bol ba'i 'jam stan bstad// dpa' bo ser po'i sga gcig bstad// a ru ra yi gser srab (khrab3bcug/ tsha ba gsum gyi g.yu mthur byas// shing mngar 'jam po'i yob chen la// bca' sga skya bo'i yob thag btags// shing kun 'khyud pa'i glo yis mnan// ka ra dkar po'i gong thag btags// dur byid smug po'i tsha smed bcug/ ma ru rtse yi lcag gis brab// mgyogs pa'i chas dang ma ldan na// dpa' pos sleb pa ga la yod// grol ma rgya mtsho'i gting nas brlag/'chi med srin sel sbyor ba la// gtum po khyung bong nga ni cha gcig la//a mṛ ta a runi cha lnga ste// a ya ldan pa rurta cha gsum bsdebs// tsa la shu dag zhes bya cha gnyis dang // kastu ra glartsini phyed du 'dod// srin dgra byi tang ka stong sel 'bu 'joms ni// sbyor ba 'di dang bungs mnyam sbyar// mgo srin so srin khong srin dang // gzhang srin lpags (pags3srin la sogs pa// tsha srin grang srin brtag mi dgos// srin gyi grong khyer kun 'joms shing // mchog tu gnyan srin glang thab (thabs3sel//gur khyung zhes bya mkhas 'ga'i bzhed srol ni// gur kum bcu gsum khyung lnga bsdebs pa yis// mgo srin ya ma nag po don glang dang // tshad rims

132 ༄7kharna rat+na'i sman yig gces btus/bar/ rgyal bo skyin gor/ blon cog krong / 'bangs su tu'o// man ngag tu bdekhyed sems la sbyar ba sogs gzhung dang man ngag gi sbyor sde gang gtong yang phal cher rno khyad sha sman dug 'don gyis 'don dgos la de'ang dug 'byin pa dang / rno 'don pa dang / ngar gdags pa dang gsum kun la shes pa gal che ste/ bdud rtsi gter mdzodar+shalas/ rtsang (rtsangs3pa che chung sbal sbrul nya// rmig bu klu yi nor yin pas// dug gsum ma bral lus lci zhing //gnyid dang sha che shes pa rmongs// bcud 'dzag bad mkhris nad slong zhing //mig 'grib chu ser tsha ba skye// zhes dang / bdud rtsi ljon shing gi zhal gdam du/sbrul ni klu yi bu yin pas// dug gsum tshang lugs mang na yang // 'dod chags zhe sdang gti mug gsum// dug gsum nus pas dbugs mi bde//gnyid che lus po lci sogs 'byung // zhes dang / de'i dug 'byin lugs de nyid las/ 'dod chags rang gi thig les sel zer yang dngul chu dur (dul3ma/ / zhe sdang ma gi ta yis 'joms// gti mug dug ni 'don pa la// sbrul sha sing por zhag gcig sbangs// de nas yos tshan nang du bsnyal// zhes dang /dug gsum gnyan (gnyen 1po go bo'i sha/ thun gcig btang ba zhal las shes// zhes bshad la nyams yig brgya rtsar/ de yi dug ni 'don lugs kyang //gla rtsi'i chu dang me nyob las// 'don pa de ni zab mo yin// zhes gsungs pas sbrul sha'i lpags (pags3pa bshus nas gla rtsi'i chu la zhag gcig sbangs/ de nas me mur nang du ser chom tsam bsregs pa gang bde bya'o// khu tshur zhal gdams du/ bya sha rnams la dug yod ma byung na// sha log skye bas dug 'don zhal la dris// zhes dang / bya sha'i dug 'don tshag sha'i nang du bya// zhes gsungs so// so so'i dug gnas pa yang / gter mdzod du rtsang (rtsangs1ba'i dug ni mgo la gnas// sbal dug nang khrol kun la khyab// sbrul dug lpags khupags3dang stod kyi cha// nya dang rmig bu'i mjug ma la// zhes dang /

142 sa〉/karma rat+na'i sman yig gces btus/sngags ni/ oṃ ha kā ma la wa ra yo swāhā/ zhes pa nyer gcig bzlas shing mi rtog tuldog1ngang la gzhagame long las sbyor gyi gdams ngag 'di la gsum ste/ rdzas sngags dmigs pa'o// dar dmar po rtsi ma yal bar me long bzang ba (bar3btum/skud pas dam por bcings la dar gyi sne mo nas lag pas gzung me la bsreg go / gnyis pa sngags ni/ sra thim sra thim me dbal sod/ ces pa'o// gong bsnyen stong tsho gcig bya/ las sbyor du brgya rtsa re me long la btab/ me long tsha mo de sbyor ba'i dus su oṃ 'dag glad sod/ dug glad sod/ ces pa'i sngags 'di kha yar zhig bgrangs la/ me long dang dar gnyis ka la gdab/ de nas me long dar gyis dril ba'i tsha mo de na sar glan/ dmigs pa ni me long dar dang bcas pa yi dam gang byed du bsgom/ na sar glan pas yi dam gyi zhal nas me 'bar te nad rtsa sbur (sbubs3du song ba ma lus pa bsreg nas gzhob tu btang bar bsam/ shul stong par bsgom mo// 'di grang skran dang grang ba'i rigs srin rigs thams cad dang ma zhu rtsa phreng / steng gdon 'og gdon pho log glang thabs sogs thams cad la phan no// me long phyi nang la bri tshul shog bkra bzhin du bri'o//ra 'dzin ni mdzo g.yag glang sogs pho yi rwa g.yas pa dang khyad par glang dmar 'og can rwa la bya ste/ de yang dpangs / — spresor lnga/ kha sor gsum/ rtse bug yungs kar lha 〉〉lha rtswa shong ba byas la rang nyid lcags kyi spyang ki che rna stoskyornyidh+wa zhig tu bsgoms la/ oṃ ro ro shag khas khas —〈spru rla bu'igyisarwa/skyes44/shag bya khyung nag po rtsar rgyug shag ces cho44rwasmra k+ṣe —— sna brgya rtsa gcig btab nas gang na sar btsugs nas 'jibs/

༄7gces bsdus 'chi med nor phreng las man ngag snying gi nor bu/ 143lhung zad tubazed1ni zangs rag la bum pa mkhyud 'khor sor bcu drugasrid sor bcu kha zlum po sor bzhi pa byas la dpangs sor lnga yi mtshams btegs shing gro ga'am shog bu la me sbar te nang du bcug de nas bskor ba'i tshul du brgyab/ lhod na cung zad brdung ba'i me nyir bsro/ sngags/ oṃ me ri dmar po sod/ lcags ri sngon po sod/ thams cad sod thum sod/ ces pa'o//dbyug bcos ni gza' skar bzang bar btus pa'i ri kha shar bltas kyi lam ltag la skyes pa'i bal bus bzos pa'i tho ba yu ba khru gang / gzungs sngags byin ldan nang 'jug ldan pa legs par bsgrubs te/ rang nyidaci sman rgyal sprul sku'i cha byed tubyad3can tho ba a ru ra rnam rgyal lo sdong du bsams te/brdung tshe 'od zer gyis nad gdon bcom par bsams la gzungs bzla'o//'di rnams kyi gdab dmigs dang phan yon sogs zhib mo ni logs su gzigs shing / sngags sna tshogs dang gsang sman chig thub skor ni/ dharmartso sarba hūṃ dharba hūṃ/ tin ghā ri/ na dhu ṭi na phu ṭi/ kha re ghā e/ tits+tsha ka re/ shrī sgo ra ṣa na thā/ sngags tshang ma lan gsum bzlas/ thal ba dang khab lhan gcig la phu gsum gdab/ thal bas khab phur/ khab de rta rngar brgyus nas ral ba'i rma grub/ thal ba la sngags phyi ma mang du btab nas rma la blugs/khrag gcod la sngags tshang ma bzlas nas thal bar skrangs na sngags tshang ma bzlas phu gdab gsum/ sngags phyi ma thal bar gdab/ rma rang la sngags phyi ma thal bar gdab pa gsum/ dhā ni pa no u pa/ dzi la ki la/ nīs sarba ki bachu si ṭa laṅgā tsho re ye laṅgā ya ye/ dhā ra rku tshe kā ṭa rku khā i mi ri bha ga tra gu ru ki sa ga tre+e/ phu ro man+t+ra i shwa ro ba ca/ dang po lcags gzer dang khab lag tu bzung nas gcig bzlas phu gdab/ de nas so na sar btsug (btsugs3lag gis bzung nas sngags nyi shu phu nyi shu/ de nas shing sdong rlon pa la gzer

144 ༄7/karma rat+na'i sman yig gces btus/gdab/ mi mngon lta bur bya/ shing ma bcad na lo nyi shu thub/ gzer lag gis bzung ba las ma zin bar sa sogs la mi bzhag ardzi nī gha r+bha rin bhu to/su tra a yo ma hā ba la ku ma ro bra h+ma tsa rī nā mra/ ha nu man+t+ra ye na mo na maḥ chu ma rtsi rigs sngags la gteratuster3/ 'bu 'byin pa'i sngags so// bi lā ni bi lā ni ti re so mi ka hang ga ye/ yasma pa tra/ pa ṭha na ga ye kya le a'i/ bhu dzi sa tra sa ri le a'i/ kā ṭi ku ṭi sang / d+ku rurnyi dza i/ zhes pa snod gtsang mar chu blangs nas der bri/ chu 'debs bzhin sngags gsum mam bdun bzla re re bzhin phu gdab re re bzhin chus kha bshal nas snod gzhan du pho/ so srin dngos su thon/ 'bu med kyang phan/ thal bar bsngags nas gong bzhin lte ba la bskus na glang thabs phan/sngags thung dug rigs 'joms byed ni/ oṃ hri na a ghu la ma ka tha tha/nor gyi god srung ni/ oṃ da ra hūṃ drung khram khram gi mo bya ya phaṭa/ chad nag po srungs shig shing byang sor bzhi pa gcig la bris nas sgo yi ya them la 'dogs/mes tshig la/ oṃ do me shi sod/so srin la/ a dang ye rdar brgya rtsa bsngags (sngags3pas phanakhu giram khrag chod/ rma khrag chod par zab/yang lhog pa cis kyang ma thub na srog chags sdom la 'jibs su gzhugayang skye ni klung sho khreb tu skye/ lo ma 'dab bzhi ral gri 'dra// 'bras bu rdog po theb (mtheb1tsam yod// lhog par 'di nyid gcig pus chog/skegs bur a mṛ'i 'dogs mtshams yu ba brdar nas 'thung / 'dab ldan khra bo'i sha khu ni// lcags snod bkol (bskolakyebs khyi dug thub// yang ril ldan ga pur nag po de// nad ngan kun la sleb pas chog / sgra ldan me rdzas dri dug tudugs1can// sna khrag dag la tshor bas chog / srog chags nag

172 ༄7/karma rat+na'i sman yig gces btus/rims tshad rgyu long la bab (babs3dang // gnyan tshad khrag dang bsdongs pa dang // dreg grum gnyan dang bsdongs pa dang // chu ser mkhal 'gram ('grams1dpyi mig gzer// ma lus sur tusel3byed khyad chos yin//bsam 'phel nor bume'i sbyor ba ni// sman gyi rgyal po bzang po drug /shing gi rgyal po tsan dan gnyis dri ldana.a ga ru gsum// srog chags rtsi yi rgyal po gnyisagi wang gla rtsi/ / gang tugangs3kyi rwa dang bseru chu yi rus nyaphyis/ / 'bru rgyal gsum a bar skyur gsum dang spod rgyal gnyis sga dmar pi ling / / zi radakar nag gnyisadang chu sman gnyisargya tsha sdig srin/ / gser zangs shing mngar 'bri ta sa 'dzin lcug ma ru rta dang // nyi dga' lcam pa sbyar ba nyer drug 'di// 'bru bcud dwangs ma'i rta la bskyon// mtshams nyid trem du gtang bar bya// yang na gung gnyis chu bskol dbul// rengs 'khums rtsa la byar ( byer3 rnying dang //mkhal tshad rtsa tshad rtsa 'gram ('grams1 dang // sman pas bcos sdud (rdugs3nad la bsngags// drang srong gza' yi nad rnams 'joms/ mchog tu rtsa nad can la shis// sur+ya'i nad rnams ma lus 'byin// rgyun shes bu yis bkod pa yin// mang (ming3yang nor bu bsam 'phel zer//le'u bcu gcig pa/ kha thor gyi nad sel ba'i sde tshan/sgang thog byi'u la phug dang // 'om bu lo ma brag skya ha// bong dmar a ru srad nag gi / thang gis sha dug ci 'dra yang // 'joms byed rma bya'i mdangs (mdongs1bdun zer//btsan dug sman chen gyis zin la// lan tshwa brag skya ha bo ni dug 'joms zung (zungs1sbyor lan tshwa sbyor| brag skya ha bo thun log cig / zhib btags chus phul/ / tshad ldan phul ba man ngag mchog /

༄7khachi med nor 'phreng gi ma bu go bsgrigs/ 173mkhris pa a ru'i gser bshal ni// gser mdog bzang po rdog gsum ste// gcig ni ba chu phul gang du// btsos pa chu de thim nas bton// gcig ni bag zan nang du btums// sla ngar du ba ma shor bsregs// zan tshig a ru ma tshig tsam// gcig ni bco lnga'i zla ba'i dus// mkhar gzhong nang bzhag nam langs bsdu// kha bsgyur thar nu dur byid gnyis// zho re'i sbu ba shrī khaṇ+ḍa mar dkar khu ba'i nang bcug mar khu rang thim 'donaril ma tsam// rgya tsha sran gsum thar nu 'dir khron chung ba btang / dpe la la byi tababyas 'dug khron chung 'thad pa 'dra bdun// 'di rnams zhib btags chu dron sbyar// srod la sbyong khuslong3 byed thun gcig btang // nam gung sbyong ('khru3byed thun gcig btang // tho rangs sbyong byed thun gcig btang // srod la sum cha nam gyi gung // sum gnyis tho rangs phyed tsam mo// btsos bsregs rjen gsum sbyor ba ste// mkhris nad dug dang nad smug po la// 'di las lhag pa'i gdam ngag med//deng sang gtar nyes khrag (log )gis/ phal cher 'chi ba kun mthong nas// de nyid gso ba'i man ngag bri// rgyu rkyen rtags dang bcos thabs bzhi//rgyu ni rtsa nang khrag shis (shas3'gag / rkyen ni 'gul bskyod drag pos skrang //dang po grang shum tshig bzhi (tshigs gzhi3na// rtsa chu tsha ba'i phyogs su ston//zug che stod rgyas chu 'bul (bur3'byung // khrag log rtags yin gso ba'i thabs// ma gtar ba yi cha dpyad skyibyad3ni// kha che rtse mo thung ba gces//stag shar brdar bas rma log thub// gtar rjes rma kha mthab (mtheb1mos mnye// de ltar byas na nyes mi 'byung // de ni thog mar bya thabs so// da ni bcos pa'i thabs bstan pa// tsha (tshwa1g.yer sga phab (phabs1pi pi ling //marasbyar zan dron dug (dugs1kyi bdugs// ma zhi ngag bcad drag po'i sngags// zhal gdams su/ zhi ku ru rbad/ myog rmug tsham so rbad/ hur thum srog la rbad/ snying khrag tshal par rbad/ nad kyi sha la rbad/ ces so// chur

174 ༄༅karma rat+na'i sman yigagaces btus/sngags rmar gdabs khong du btang // ma thub 'dzin pa gangs (gang1chung stong ri zil// lcags tig gla ba'i dri thon chu sbyar btang // gang nyer gtar zhing zas spyod bsil la brtenaskyobasten1/ / des kyang ma phan gi wang gu gul dkar po/ / gur gum gla rtsi brag zhun3bshal gyis sbyangs// 'phar ba'i rtsa rnams me yis bros lam bcad// 'grul 'dzem zhi bcos sha chang drod bcud spangs// rnag tu shor na rus tshig tutshigs3zangs thal dang // gna' rus sbyor ba byis pa dar ma dang // rgan po bad mkhris rlung la legs par sbyar/gtar kha gdab cing rma la 'bu zhugs na// bya rgod spos dang gtsang g.yer byi rug pa// gang rnyed chur sbang rma la yang yangagadab//'bras bu gsum dang sle tre+es ba sha'i thang // khrag rlung dwangs snyigs 'byed cing ngan khrag sna ru 'dren// gtar khas 'byed thang klu sgrub snying po'i lugs//rdo yi rgyal po bzhi ni/ sbal rgyab dkar po smug po gnyis/ chig thub dkar po smug po gnyis yin no//spos dkar thal ka rdo rje so ma ra// ru rta ba sha ka dang 'bras bu gsum//sle tres brag zhun ka ra gu gul bcu/ / dreg grum chu sel tuser3go khuko3ler tsha 'khyugs sel// / /

178 ༄7/karma rat+na'i sman yig gces btus/le'u dang po/ man ngag rgyud zhus pa/de yang / a thā zhes pa brda sprod kyi gzhung las/ bkra shis rgyun mi chad pa stsol/ dri dang mtha' dag a thā'o zhes/ rgyud kyi dbur bkra shis pa'i tshig dang rgyud don rgyun mi chad pa'i nges tshig dang / rtsa bshad kyi rgyud gsungs pa de ma thag pa nas/ man ngag lag len gyi rgyud 'dir rig pa'i ye shes kyis stsol ba'i slad du yid las skyes kyis dri ba dang tshig don mtha' dag ma tshang ba med pa dang / yang na a thā dbang du bya ba ste yan lag brgyad kyi brjod bya rjod byed tshang la 'dus pa'i dbang du bya ba zhes sbyar bas/ de nas ji lta ji snyed gshis sam babs kyi chos rgyu 'bras nges par ston pas ston pa/ chos thams cad spros pa'i mtha' bcom pas chos sku/ bcom ldan srid zhi mtha' dag las 'das pas sprul sku/ sems can thams cad kyi ma rig pa'i 'ching ba las gso ba'i 'tsho mdzad/ sman ni brda rnying las phan pa'i don/ bla ma ste/ de las gong na med pa/ be+eḍūr+ya sku mdog sngon po mtshan dpe ldan pas/ ting nge 'dzin snga ma de las bzhengs te dgos pa yid la 'dod pa tsam gyis thams cad thogs med du 'byung zhes bya ba'i sems can thams cad la phan pa'i ting nge 'dzin zhes dang / yang gsum pa man ngag rgyud la bslab pa ni/ gzhung don spyi dang bye brag gnyis las/ dang po 'gro mchog gtso bor gyur pa mi lus kyang /gnyis pa bye brag ni/ spyir gdams dang skabs bco lnga gnyis las dang po brjod pa'i thog mar/ de la nyes pa khong nad tshad pa zhes dang / gnyis pa skabs bco lnga'i sgo nas dri ba bskul ba dang dri ba gnyis kyi dang po/ kye drang srong chen po yid las skyes/ zhes dang / gnyis pa mjug don gnyis las dang por/ drang srong chen po rig pa'i ye shes lags/ zhes dang / gnyis pa

༄cukhadod 'byung man ngag yon tan nor bu'i bang mdzod kyi lde mig 179mjug don/ bdud rtsi 'chi ba med pa/ snying po gso dpyad yan lag brgyad/snod min la gsang ba man ngag gi lag len ma sbas pa/ tshe yi rig byed kyi don 'dzin cing sdud pa'i rgyud las zhus pa'i le'u dang po'o//le'u gnyis pa/ rlung nad bcos pa/ rlung ni rang rgyud gdug cing nad mang por tsub pa'i phyir dang / bskyed rlung mtshan nyid drug ces pa/ rtsub yang grang phra sra g.yo drug shugs bkag ces zas skom bkres par bkag nas/ nan gyis btsir ba ni bshang lci khu ba btsir ba dang / bkres bkag khu ba'i shug (shugs3bkag mi bya'o// rkyen des rang gnas 'phel zhing bsogs(gsog3/ dpyi sked rus tshigs rna ba reg bya/ khyad par ma zhu'i gnas long rnams so// 'jug sgo drug shar rgyas rus zhen rtsar rgyug pags grams don babs snod lhung drug go / lus la bde ba'i go skabs med pa/ rlung nad drug cu rtsa gsum la/ bye brag dbye ba nang tshig (tshegs3bco lnga mi brtsi/ rigs nyi shu la/ a ba (wa1rta dang da rgan gnyis zhes/ phyir dgye nang 'gugs (gug3gnyis rtsis nas nyi shu/ mdor bsdus brgyad gnas kyi dbye ba nyer brgyad/ mgo rlung sogs bdun/ khyon drug cu rtsa gsum 'byung ngo // rlung srog 'dzin sogs lnga la/ mkhris pa 'dres pa lnga bad kan 'dres pa lnga dang bcu/ bsdoms naris lnga gsum bco lnga nang tshig (tshegs3'dod pa'o// spyi don brtag pa'i thabs rnam pa gsum/ dang po slong rgyu/ gnyis pa mtshan nyid da rgan phyir dgye brang 'bur gnya' ba brdungs (bstungs3zhes/ gnya' ba 'khums pa gzugs 'khums shing rkang lag sor mo'i bya ba nyams na bi sha rtse/ skyug cing langs tshe phyir 'gyel kha bub tu 'jil('gyel3/ phyi rol gyi ri dang yul snang g.yo zhing 'khyom/ mchin rlung

180 ༄7/karma rat+na'i sman yig gces btus/sgreg cing stod gzer sgal 'dabs kyi bshul sha de na/ mchin pa 'phyong thag chad ces mchin dri dang 'brel thag chad pa snyam byed pa'o// kha zas mi 'ju bsus (gsus3khrag 'dres zer ba/ rlung rgyu ba'i lam bsus khugasus3pa'i khrag gis bkag nas khrag 'dres pa'o// yan lag gi tshigs 'khrul zhing 'phyes pa ste lhod lhod por gyur cing bshal ba/ dbugs ngan zhes 'og rlung dang dri chu sdom pa/ lo shur ni rnyid pa'am ras pa zhes bam sung (sungs3can gyi sngo tshod la'o// spyi don lnga pa bcos thabs/ lo yib pa zhes lug sha lo grangs yib tu bcug pa/ sre long pa sog pa'i yu ba tshang ra'i gzhug gu chung de gsum rus bcud gsum bsdus/ spod btab btang zhes sga pi ling btab gnyis pa chang zan chang phyi rgyud ltar bya/ gsum (pa )'don sbyor/ bzhi pa phye ma/ sle tres sgog skya zhes sgog thal/ dzā ti shing kun gtso bor btang zhes/ tsha na dzā ti grang na shing kun thunatsholog bya/ sre long sog yu gzhug chung rus bcud gsum/ sha rnying mar rnying bur rnying chang gar ma bcud bzhi zhes/ lnga pa sman mar btsan dug rus chen zhes mi 'phyi ba rta bong g.yag sogs kyi rus pa/ 'bras bu gsum a bar skyur gsum/ rtsa ba lnga'i sman mar rtsa ba lnga yin no// nad gzhan bad mkhris 'dres pa la snum bcos spang / lag len rin chen gter spungs su a ru lcum rtsa dur byid 'o ma'am sha khur btab pa'i sbyang bya gsungs so//gnya' ba sgur na 'bur po dgos an stong gi 'og gi tshigs pa de dang por byas pas/ bye brag gso thabs rgyas bsdus gnyis kyi/ a brta (warta3la snum dugs rus rnying 'ba' cha phying pa snum ldan mar btsos dugs bya/ sna sbyong ni/mgron bu bong dkar sug pa sga skya bsregs thal byang ba rgya tsha dri chur sbyar ba phyi rgyud ltar btang / rgya shug ni/ ba da ra la zhes dang / ka rkan dhu zhes bod du de ba dā ru gtsang 'gram du skye ba'i thog bu khro zhal can de'o// thang shing sgron me shing / 'bri lug gi sha khu bu ram rtsabs nas skyes pa'i zan slong ba skyur rtsabs/

242 ༄7/karma rat+na'i sman yig gces btus/skyer pa gnyis/ a ru 'bigs byed/ ti tsha ser po ni zha nye'i rdo dmar ser 'ong can ljid che ba de'o// drag turag1dud ni ra gan bzhu ba'i dud pa/ mig tshag kun la big pan/ sag rtsi ni (nīkyel thod (tho3ṭha ma rnyed na zangs zho lan tshwa med pas btub/ tsha ba sga pi pho/ rting pa'i dregs tudreg3pa yod med kyi mtshams/ gsal byed bdun pa'i steng du spadung rtse dang sgrul sha bsnan pas lde gu btang / a ru 'bigs byed/ bul tog rdo mkhris ni ser po ro kha ba/mtshe ldum dang / spyin dang / btsag yug ni rdo dmar po 'khregs tumakhregs3pa/ rgya mtsho'i sbu tulbu3ba/ mgo rus sems can gang rung gi rus pa snum med/shing mngar ra mnye gnyis ni ra mnye nye shing / a ru 'bigs byed/ pi ling /ta bya gser rdo yin yang zer sga skya yin yang zer ba 'dug a ba bco lnga pa ni cong zhi bsil gsum ni cu gur li/ 'bras bu gsum a bar skyur/ lcags phye a ba rnam gnyis 'di la kha gcig rtsa a (ba )pho mo gnyis yin zer/ 'ga' zhig a ba dang rdo mdung rtse yin zer/ dpe cha rnying pa la la'i mchan bur rtsa a ba dang sngo dga' (sga3gnyis yin zer gsal rtsa sngo yin pa de don gnas par gda' 'o// sman sgrul sdig pa nag pa nag po yin nam snyam/ zhag nyi shu gcig 'o mar sbang bsrul ba'i mar khyim bya pho gso/ rgyal mo chu 'byed ni a ru ra 'bigs byed dang dom mkhris/ rab rib sel zhes sman 'di rnams zhib btags dar tshag (tshags3la drangs dar gyis gtum ting phor du chu khyor gang la sman khu dmar legs su 'ong ba sbangs la snga dro gang 'byed steng du bal yes btig dar gcig bzhag de 'dra zhag bcu'am zla phyed bya'o// smra ba bcad de sgang (sgong 3spris zhu zhes pa 'di dpe rnying phal cher khu ba zhes 'byung ba dag pa 'dra zhu bar zhes bshad pa go bar ma byung de nyid mig la 'debs dus sngags lan nyi shu rtsa (gcig )re bzlas mchil ma khong du btang / mig la sman byug 'phral du sngags ci mang re gdab/ ba yi lci ba'i nang du ra'i mtsher pa bcug

༄khyakhadod 'byung man ngag yon tan nor bu'i bang mdzod kyi lde mig 243pa'i nang pi ling bcug nas bsregs pa grib skams byas pa'i phye ma sbrang dang sbyar ba'i lde gu mig la byug zhu mkhan gyis dugs bya mtheb mos mnyes/ de rjes a ru 'bigs byed lde gu byug dpyad byas bshul (shul3gyi nad lhag ma lus gcod ces pa'i lag len ni yan lag brgyad par/ 'bras bu gsum ni gang rung ba'i// shun pa chur btags lde gu byas// khams phor sbyar ba'i nang du bsregs// de nas tshig nas phye mar btags// sman ni lhag ma'i khu ba yis//so sor legs par bgos nas ni// snag tsha de skams slar yang btags// rgya tsha gnyis 'gyur bcas (gces3pa yin// mig sman gsum po de dag ni// phyi ba'i mchog tu mu khyud bshad// ces so// rab rib ling ro la gong gi a ru'i lde gu nus ldan bsregs pa sogs byas pa de'o// sngo rib dang ling ro srab mor rgyal mo chu 'byed ni gong gi a ru dang dom mkhris rgya skyegs dang zhes pa nas rab rib sel zhes pa'i bar de yin/ pa yag ces pho rog nor bu ste/ lug ru dkar po lug ru smug po/ zhim thig le ni mig sman sangs rgyas/ sag rtsi zhes ni spyonī3la thod (tho3ṭha/ 'dzib bu ka bul tog zas spyod khong sman sogs mig gi spyi bcos dag la 'bad/ 'khru skyugs dang ya ma'i mgo gzer yod pa/nad pa'i lus shing yin gnam lo'i lus lcags la bab (babs3pa lta bu'o dgra dar/ spar kha li la skyes pa li la bab (babs1par spar kha'i kag yin zhing de bzhin du bud med khams/ 'dus pas mig tshil zhu ba gang du 'dus pa mig zhu rdzi ma nang du zug ces pa de nyid de dbyer mi rung / 'byed pa'i dus 'das rgyal mo'i mthu nyams pas 'byed du med pa dbye mi rung / dbye rung ba de rnams las zlog (ldog3pa chu nang du zhag thigs 'dra ba'i zla ba nya gang ba skya khor re ba dbye bar bya/ rlung gis 'gribs pa lo gsum song na smin/ bad kan gyis 'gribs pa lo gcig song ba/ 'dus pa lo phyed gnyis song ba/mkhris pa zla ba drug song ba smigadu dbye la/ ma smin par 'dug na gnod zas

248 ༄7/karma rat+na'i sman yig gces btus/bsnan pas sum cu tham pa kha nad/ gre mchu'i sha men de brud la lcags kyis bsregs/ seng phrom 'jib rtsi ni spri (pri3yang ku 'brasabu gsum a bar skyur/sge gsher ni sga rgod dmar po/ pa ṭha ni gu yu/ srin lag g.yon gyi tshigs bar 'og lag yu ngos rgyus pa ma song tsam ste mtsher rtsa yod pa'i phyi rol bsregs/skyu ru'i thang btang mchu dang gang nye'i rtsa dang mtsher rtsa rta mthur dang srin lag rgyab rtsa gtar/ khyi sbre ni 'og can gyi rmongs spu lham mthil gyi skrad rnying sbyar ba/sman khus so nub par mkhur ba bkang nas dbo/ sna yi sman yung sbrang sbyar so snyil (rnyil3nub par mkhur bkang la yun ring du bzhag dzā ti —shing kun sogs rlung 'joms/ mur 'gram steng gi so'i 'phar rtsa mes mnan/ sman mar phyi rgyud ltar sbyar/ skyu ru'i thang btang so rtsa rtse chung dpung rtsa gtar/ rgya skyegs skyer pa ka ra sbyar ba'i khu ba so snyil (rnyil1nub par mkhur ba bkang la yun ring du bcang zhing phyir dbo/ so srin rta gseb sngon po'i sbangs/ sa rdzi ka snye nag ma dang mar sbyar mkhur bar so snyil turnyil1nub par byas la dgang /tig ta thang phrom sag rtsi ni tunī3la thod (tho1 ṭha mkhar gong mes bsregs bdug chu nang du sgyed bu btsug (btsugs1pa'i steng du rdo leb bzhag pa'i khar mkhar gong srin can bsreg pa dmar lam me ba bzhag pa'i steng du sman btab pa'i dud pa cha dpyad du rngubs kyi sbubs nas so na sar bdug pas srin bu chu nang du brul ba yin no// gshul (bshul—1chags kyi tshil de gong bzhin bdug ri dwags sha ba'i tshil/ bye ni phye ma leb stag ni rmigs bu yin yang zer ba ril bu so steng bzhag rna ba dang gang nye ba'i rna drung gang nye dang /srin lag gi tshigs mgo dang phyi mkhrig ma'i ma tums3 zur gyi rus pa tshig 'bur mgo de bsregs/ mkhur bkang 'o mar rlung sman btab pa'i sna sman btang / mkhris gyur shing mngar rgun 'brum ka ra mngar bas so snyil (rnyil3nub pa mkhur ba kang lce rtsa gtar/ bad gyur ske tshe spar gang cha bskyed tsha
