༄7/'dod 'byung man ngag yon tan nor bu'i bang mdzod kyi lde mig 279le'u re lnga pa/ me dbal gyi nad bcos pa/bcos thabs spyi bye brag gnyis las dang po thog mar gang nye ba'i rtsa gtar phyi rgyud ltar lto sbyongs/ stod du byung na rlon zhes skyugs 'dren pa'i brda/chu ngan ni 'khrig pa spyad dus kyi khams min pa'i chu nyag ring po ba lang gi kha chu 'dra ba de yin la ma rnyed na dri chu'o// mkhris gyur pad rtsa ni chu la skyes pa pad ma dngos ma rnyed na puṇ+ḍa ri ka'i rtsa ba/ shel te (ta3ni mdung shing gi thang chu/brtsag tubatreg3yug rnams/ 'dam bu ka ra ni rtsa bu ram//le'u re drug pa/ sur ya'i nad bcos pa/sur ya zhes spyir skran rigs khong 'bras sur ya rnams la khyad par cher med kyang skran ni ma zhu bas bskyed pa shas che zhing ngo bo 'dril ba dang khong 'bras ni zas la 'khren cing zug rngu chung la ngo bo bam pa/ sur+ya ni khrag ngan don snod kyi rtsa dmigs su 'dus pas ngo bo skrangs pa zug ju dang bcas shing gzhug rnag tu smin pa'o// spyi rtags dang po glo ba'i sur+ya bya brun ni phug ron brun/ dngul chu'i ril bu zhes gong du le'u lnga bcu nga dgu pa chu ser gso skabs dngul chu mu zi seng ldeng so ma ra zhes pa na sbrang rnams chu ser 'joms pa'i gnyen po yin zhes pa'i bar gyi sbyar ba de'o// rwa co sna tshogs/ mkhris pa sna tshogs/ bzang drug ni cu gur li dza sug ka sbrang sbyar skem par byed//le'u re bdun pa/ rmen bu'i nad bcos pa/rmen bu ni yan lag brgyad par nad ni bad kan shas che ba// khrag dang

280 ༄7/karma rat+na'i sman yig gces btus/sha dang tshil brten// zlum zhing mtho la sra ba (skrangs pa3ste// mdud pa 'dra bas rmen bur bshad// ces gsungs so// bcos thabs gsum las dang po gsar dus pra tshil ni sbrang rtsi las byung shog bu bskus/ bya bra ni phug ron brun/chu ma rtsi ni mkha' 'gro la phug bsregs steng khra bo'i lum (lums1ni gzhung 'di'i yan lag gi rma bcos bshad pa 'i gso bar// des kyang ma thub (na)khra bo'i chas kyis gdul// yung skyer chu rtsa btsod zhun phabs tshos rams so thog wa spyang gong mo sbre sprel brun// ri bong ril ma zhun nag gang 'phrod sbyar//zhes pa de'o// stag tsher ni kaṇ+ḍa ka ri'i dkar/ seng tsher ni skug po yin/tshil gyur gu gul zhes gu gul brag zhun spang spos skyer khaṇ+ḍa rgya spos sbrang rnams bza' zhing / bye rug ni sngo sman 'khrungs dper bye rug pa yi mtshan nyid ni/lo ma mthing shun rnga yab 'dra// 'bras bu mu men mchod rten 'dra// ro ni bska la yid tsam tsha// bod kyi zhing gi mu la skye// zhes pa ste nu ma thogs pa'o//'bras phreng lums kyis btul ni 'bras 'dul mi yi rkang mgo nya yi sha spru rtsa re lcags (lcag1chang btsos lums su bzhug ces pa de'o//le'u re brgyad pa/ rlig rlugs kyi nad bcos pa/snum dugs ni/ 'ba' cha'am 'ol skom gyi ngh+rugs/ sman mar ni phyi rgyud ltar rtsa ba lnga'i mar/ mkhris gyur lums ni bsil sman sna tshogs kyi lums/long rtsa gtar/ drod kyi lums dugs ni rdo bsros/ tshil byur (gyurakyebye rug brgyad ni/ spang spos brag zhun yung skyer a bar skyur gsum sbyar ba'i lums/rligasrubs med pa pags pa dral la tshil phyung —rma bkrus btsem zhes yan lag brgyad par rma ni sbrang rtsi nag mtshur dang / rgyam tshas nges par bskus la btsem zhes so// go phye (bye3zhes go ni bya phur leb/ phye (bye1ni ma nu khrag can/

༄7/'dod 'byung man ngag yon tan nor bu'i bang mdzod kyi lde mig 281snum dugs ni 'ba' cha'am 'ol skom gyi dugs bya/ sgo nga skrangs na rtsa thag ni spu nag gi rtsa yin la bsregs/ rgyu lam bsreg ces yan lag brgyad par/ de nas chu sor gnas pa ni// zla b.rī kham pa'i kha 'dra bas// rlung lam bsgag phyir bsreg par bya// zhes gsungs so// srin lag rgyus pa bcad la bsregs zhes yan lag brgyad par mthe bong steng gi rgyus pa ni/ ser po snal ma 'dra ba gang /khab kyi btegs la thad ka ru// gang na yod pa de bcad de// gzhan deg de las logs (logakyegazhan gyi// srin lag sor mo bsreg ces// zhes gsungs so// le'u de dgu pa/ rkang bam gyi nad btsos pa/na ba'i zug gzer chung bas rkang bam zhes yan lag brgyad par dang po chu sor gnas pa 'am zhes pa nas de ni rkang bam zhes bshad do// zhes pa'i bar dang rlan can yun du 'byung zhes de nyid las de ni mang du 'dzag pa dang //lo gcig 'das pas spang bar bya// zhes dang / yang de nyid las kha gcig lag pa sna dang mchu// zhes pa nas/ yun ring du ni gnas par byed// ces pa'i bar sogs gsungs so// bcos thabs rlung gyur dugs zhes yan lag brgyad par rkang bam rlung gyur 'phel ba la// snum gyi (dugs)bya dkri ba dang //long mo'i sor gnyis gong du ni// gtar ga gdab par bya ba'o| zhes gsungs so// mkhris gyur yan lag brgyad par mkhris gyur long mo'i 'og tu ni// khrag dbyung mkhris pa sel kun sbyar// bad gyur zhes yan lag brgyad par bad kan las gyur mthe bo las// khrag gtar nas ni kha zas ni// sbrang rtsi dang bcas sman khu blud// ces dang yungs dkar bṛ ha ti gnyis kyi rtsa ba'i lde gu byug par bya/ yang na 'u su'i lde gu byug ces gsungs so// de ltar le'u

282 ༄7/karma rat+na'i sman yig gces btus/bdun ni lhan skyes rma gso ba ste skabs brgyad pa'o//le'u bdun cu pa/ mtshan bar rdol ba'i nad bcos pa/yan lag brgyad par mi dge smin par gyur pa dang // 'phral du dam pa la smad pas// phal cher 'brum phran dang por 'byung // zhes gsungs so// de rtags spyi bye brag gnyis las dang po spyi rtags/ bad mkhris tsha skrangs 'dus pa zhes yan lag brgyad par 'dus gyur rkang pa'i mtheb mo 'dra// nad ni sna tshogs 'byung 'gyur zhing // gzer dang skom dad yi ga 'chus// rims dang rlon sogs kyis gnod byed// yal bar bor la smin pa dang // rma nyid du ni 'gyur ba yin// zhes gsungs so// gso thabs gnyis las dang po gsar dus gtar zhes yan lag brgyad par sbyong ba gtar ga chu blugs sogs/ ci nas smin par mi 'gyur ba// de ni 'bad de gso bar bya// zhes gsungs shing thor pa brtol zhes/ yan lag brgyad par/ gting ring legs par brtag bya zhing // rtsa ba'am ni rtsa mo 'am// phyi bltas nang du bltas pa brtags// de las nang bltas btsal nas ni// gtsags bus legs par bcad par bya//phyir bltas ma lus par bcad la// thal sman dag gis gso bar bya// de nas thal sman btab pa'am// yang na sman pas me btsa' gdab// ko tshags kha brgya sbubs gcig pa// bcug nas legs par bcad par bya// de 'drubs nas ni lhag ma'ang bcad// gzhan du gzhang ni zhig na 'chi// zhes dang ngos la gcod pa gshol phyed pa// ngos gnyis su ni gshol gyis bcad// 'dzag pa'i lam ni ma lus pa// thams cad me yis bsregs par bya// zhes gsungs so// ra gsum ni a bar skyur zas spyod 'du ba'i rigs dang bstun zhes rkyang pa ldan 'dus gang yin bstun/ de ltar le'u bdun ni lhan skyes rma gso ba ste

༄khya/'dod 'byung man ngag yon tan nor bu'i bang mdzod kyi lde mig 283skabs brgyad pa'o//le'u don gcig pa/ byis pa nyer spyod/dang po nyer spyod brtsas skyibatsas3dus shis (dang mi shis brtag)/ mgo sra tshogs chung zhes gsung rab spyi nas dpral ba'i dbyes che ba/ sna ba'i gzengs mtho ba zhes sogs 'byung / go ldog ni gong gi ltas bzang pos de rnams las go ldog pa dang bcas te skyes/ bkra shis pa'i tshig de skad brjod/lte ba sor bzhi bcing zhes yan lag brgyad par/ bde bar gyur nas lte ba ni//sor bzhi'i 'og tu srad bus bcing // de yi 'og tu bcad nas ni// lte ba la ni brtod de gzhag/ de 'og lte ba ru rta yi// til mar gyis ni bsku bar bya//zhes gsungs so// gur gum hrīḥ ni gsung gi sa bon bris pas smra mkhas shing lce bde bar 'gyur ro// gla rtsi'i chu blud mar sbyar byin zhes yan lag brgyad par/ de nas 'dzub (mdzub3mo g.yas pa ni// bkrus pas rkan ni btegs nas kyang // mgo bor ras bal snum can g.yog/ blo dang tshe dang stobs bskyed phyir// shu dag pra ma bi sha li// shaṃ ka puṣ+ṭha'i lde gu ni// sngags btab ha re ṇa tsam sbyin// zhes so// bu ma shi ba'i nu ma blud ces yan lag brgyad par/ ma nyid kyi ni nu zho blud// de yi lus ni 'phel byed yin// de med ma ma shin tu byams// skyon med 'khrig pa spang pa dang // rigs dang rang bzhin de dang mnyam// nad med lang tsho dar la bab// bu ma shi zhing brkam chags med// gnyis kyi 'o ma blud par bya// zhes so// gsol mchod bya zhing lha ni rang la 'go ba'i lha'i rten gzugs/ le dbu pa'i slob dpon spyan drangs pho srog mda' dang mo srog 'phang la gnas pa'i phyir bca'/ gnam gta' steng thog tu bar gta' bar khang du bcug sa gta' 'og khang rmong skyormang3du

284 〉〉/karma rat+na'i sman yig gces btus/gzug sgo gta' sgo la gzug lag pa gnyis mgul du shu dag gdags zhes yan lag brgyad par/ mchog tu rtag par shu dag ni// lag gnyis mgul dang spyi bor gdags// des ni tshe dang yid gzhungs dran// bde ba skyed byed gdon las bsrung // zhes so// zla dus zhes btsas pa'i zla ba dus tshigs ma 'khyag par gtor ma dang bshos bu lha la 'bul gdon la glud btang / btsas skar nam (nabs3so skyes lta bu dang / lha ni tshangs byin lta bu/ nye du las dras zhes chags la mngon dga'i sras zla ba la mngon dga' lta bu dang / snyan zhing ni lho dbang tshe ring lta bu/ shi/sa pa'i ming ni bkris don 'grub lta bu/ming ni kha 'cham zhes pha ma nye du thams cad gros la ming kha 'cham la gdags/sri'uyin zhes sri thar tshe ringartelta bu/ thar thar ni zla ba re re bzhin ming spo/pa tra ni go yu/ dbyangs can mar zhes 'di lho phyogs rgya mtsho'i 'gram na gnas tshangs pa'i bu mo tshe dang tshig snyan stsol nus pa la dper mdzad pas nyi ma lho phyogs na gnas pa pha ma 'dzoms shing rigs bzang ba'i bu mo'i lag nas byung ba'i mar yin dgos so// a byag seng phram ltaphrom3dang pa la ni ha lo'i rtsa ba a ba se ni yungs dkar zhes yan lag brgyad par/ btsod dang seng phrom da da ka/ ku dan na ḍa pa la gnyis// ha se che chung gnyis dang ni// mud ga bsil ba gzhon nu rnams// ras bal sa bon bcas pa dag/ chur bskol ba dang mar dang ni// thal sman zho kha chur bskol bas// so skyes las byung sna tshogs nad// 'di yis myur du 'joms byed ces// 'od bsrung gon pos bshad pa yin// zhes 'byung / rgya sran zhes 'di mud ga zhes bya ba ste sran zlum dkar po yin la 'di nyid dang sran dkar mā sha zhes pa dbyibs mkhal zho sha 'dra ba kha dog dkar po can/ —'jam dkar blo 'phel bsgrub pa'i rdzas de ma 'khrul bar dgos pa yod do// zho kha chu zhes la la dar ba la la zho'i steng gi chu yin zer/ ya bak+ṣar ni sa sman bag phye 'dra ba gtong / sbyin bsreg na zhi ba

rgu/'dod 'byung man ngag yon tan nor bu'i bang mdzod kyi lde mig 285dgos skem byed ni gdon bcos bya//le'u don gnyis pa/ byis pa'i nad bcos pa/las mkhan pho nya rgyal zhes 'gong po ste/ dkor bdag bsen ni mo ste gson 'dre ma/ srog rtsa sha nad ces sha nad srin gnyis pa bshad pa snga phyi ldog go/ skad gnya' ni skad kyi gdangs zhen (zhan3 pa/ khyad par ni dang po rags pa'i brang nad rgod/ rtsa ni 'phar rtsa/ sgo ni don snod yul/ a 'bras ni mig gi 'bras zlog 'thib ni shes pa bying / spyi rtags de rnams la tsha grang gnyis/ mthil bzhi ni rkang lag gi mthil/ ngu skad gcod sdom byed ces ngu 'phral la 'phro gcod cing 'phro bcad 'phral la ngu / sa zos ni byis pas zos pa pho bar 'khar ba pho ba/ sgangs ni skrangs pa ltar dri ma 'gag rlung gyur ma'i nu zho chur blugs pas chu steng 'phyo/ mkhris gyur ma'i nu zho ser/ bad kan nu zho sngo/ tshom bur chad ni ma'i nu zho chu nang blugs pa tshom bur chad na gdon ngo yin zhes/ nu zho skyon med ni/ yan lag brgyad par/ gang zhig chu nang gcig tu 'dres// nyes pa yod pa ma yin te// 'o ma de ni skyon med ces gsungs so// tshags kyi dang po mig nad sgra ngan zhes 'di la byis pa skye dus nas mig nad can du byung na pra mtshan ngan pas pra ngan zer/ glo bur du byung na sgra ngan zer zhes pa la la nas gsung gi 'dug go / sgra ngan 'phral tshag gnyis zhes 'grel pa 'dod 'jor dra/ ngan zhes 'don dgos te legs nyes kyi pra ngan pas don tam zhes bkra shis rnam rgyal gsung ngo // khye'u skye dus nas tshag na pra (sgra )ngan dang rjes su byung na 'phral tshag ces 'byung / ma rlung ni lhan skyes par rnag 'dzag gnyis pa 'grams ni glo bur yin te rna rtsa skrangs/kha nad rtsa (btsa' ) thor zhes 'di lhan skyes yin te tsha med pa'i thor ba'o //

286 ༄7/karma rat+na'i sman yig gces btus/ser sha'i tshod ma 'dra zhes sha mo ser po 'dra 'khru/ sna skams ba rgya chags zhes sna'i phyi nang du ba mo lta bu skya khob dang sdom rgya 'dra ba 'ong / lhag par mig lta ba ltar a 'bras lkog tuldog3pa 'dzum mi shes/ mchin pas lte bar sleb zhes mchin pa'i zungs shor nas thur du 'phyang ba/ mig lce zhes sogs khongs su las kyi dbang po'i mtshan ma dang yan lag thams cad pa sdud dgos dbang po thams cad bkrag shor/ zas sman dpyad bzhi gsungs kyang lnga yod/ ma'i nu zho 'thung ba'i dus sman dpyad ma bu gnyis ka la bya/ nu zho spangs nas zas gzhan za ba'i dus na sman dpyad bu la bya/ 'jam pos bcos zhes yan lag brgyad par/ gnad dang gnod bya de nyid dang // rims sogs nad kyang de nyid 'byung / de bas sman ni de nyid de// gzhon sha can dang lus chung phyir//zas kun bsten par mi byed pas// 'di yi tshad ni nyung du sbyin// zhes gsungs so// bye brag bcos ni rags pa'i dong po'i dang po brang nad tsha ba zasasnan zhes dang / skrangs la chu mda' bsdeg tubardeg3 skyangs (skrangs3sobs nas drug mgo gtar/ ske stong ni ca (tsa1ra khung thur du tshon do bzhal ba'i sa ru bsregs/ stod du skrangs na spyi gtsug bya rog mig ces dkar nag mtshams nas gyen du tshon gang bcal/ de nas g.yas g.yon du tshon re phun re bcalab dpal khab/ de steng tshon gang bcal ba bya rog mig go / ltag pa ni sdud sgo bsreg shing mngar sogs sbyor ba btang zhes sman de zhu dus gdong byibs la rngul dbyung gting thon nas bal gyis phyi/ snod ka ru thung khrag dang /sbyar zhes zungs khrag mi gtar nad khrag gtar ba'o// bya pho rtsa (tsi1rtsi (tsi3ni gro dmar can yang zer bang ru ba yang zer me tog sngon po can no// lus skrangs spos dkar bshal zhes dur byid a bar skyur gsum gyi sbyong / gur gum gsum zhes 'di mnga' ris nas 'ong ba'i gure gum bzang shos de dang a tsa ras khyer 'ong ba'i le rgan rtse (le brgan rtsi3dang pri yang ku dang tshogasum yin no//

288 ༄7/karma rat+na'i sman yig gces btus/gsum me yis sdom/ mtsher nad g.yon gyi rtsib steng du mtsher steng yin pas bsreg gyong ni rtsams (rtsam3pa sngo ngad sha rid bsil spang / mdun ni pho gsang dbus ma dang rgyab kyi tshigs pa bcu gnyis pa bsreg long nad se 'bru drug ces kha ru tsha sga pi pho rgyam tsha sbyar/ long gsang ni lte ba'i g.yas g.yon tshon re bcal long phug gi gsang bsreg ser pho gnyis ni yung ba skyer pa/pa tra ni go yu/ rtsa mkhris ni khur chung / zho ras gdon zhugs de yi gso ni gdon ngos bzung ba ste bcos bya ba sogs bya'o// zhib tshags kyi dang po mig nad/ gsal byed sman mar phyi rgyud (nas)bshad pa de btang / sa mtshur ni mtshur dkar chu grang la sbang / bsen mo la zhi drag gi bcos bsrung ba dang gdags pa dang bskrad las bya/ an stang (stong3tshigs pa dgu pa bdun pa bsreg ma zhig byug pa zhes byi brun ser tsam brngos pa nu zhos bran pa'i byug pa bya'o//le'u don gsum pa/ byis pa'i gdon bcos pa/rnge bud med gzugs can bdun te zhes dril bas bcu gnyis yan lag brgyad pa ltar dang rgyal bsen gnyis gzhan nas kha bkang ste/ skyes bu'i gzugs can lha gnod pa'i rtags/ ngos gcig tsha la ngos gcig grang / zhes yan lag brgyad par yan lag ngos gcig grang la / ngos gcig dro ba nyid yin no// kha dog sna tshogs 'khru zhes de rnams ni yan lag brgyad pa ltar bshad pa'o// las mkhan zhes pho nya gnyis rgyal gsen tubasen3gnyis gzhan nas kha bkang ste 'chad cing / srog 'dod ni gso ba dka' zhing / yas 'dod ni gso ba sla ba yin/ srog 'dod ni sngon las kyi tshul du smin gyi 'byung bas gso dka'/ yas 'dod gdon de kyal ka ltogs 'dod yi tshul du gso sla/

༄7/'dod 'byung man ngag yon tan nor bu'i bang mdzod kyi lde mig 291la sum char gdu/ lcum rtsa srang gcig chu phul gang la sum char bsdu/ dwa tsha zho gang chu phul gang khrag tshod tsam du bsdu de gsum grang pa dang bsres la sga dang shing tsha zho gnyis gnyis 'ol mo dang khron bu zho re re rgya tsha sran tsam dur byid mdzub gang so sor zhib btags kha tshar du btab la btang ngo / gar+bha ni sbang bslad/ tsaṇ+ḍa li ni 'ol mo'am thar nu/ tri byi ta ni dur byid dmar po/ ha ri ta ni a ru ra/ zhim shing 'di ni lcum rtsa tha dad ma yin yang deng sang lcum rtsa sdong po yod pa la byed snang ba brtags bsdus khur btang / rjes gcod ni phyi rgyud kyi sbyang zhes bya/ me tog ces me tog sna tshogs/ grogs (grog3shing ni gyang rnying sogs la chags pa'i spang gi rnam pa can/ bya bra ni phug ron brun/sku mnye byas rjes zhes dang po nang gi rtsa gsher gyi byang pa ni khra bo/ gser gyi bye ma ni deng sang shing 'bras la byed pa nor/ dkar rtsi ni mchod rten sogs la byug pa'i dkar rtsi/ mthing ni rdo mthing dngos/ lha'i de ba dā ru zhes dri'am spos nyag rong tren dan nam shug pa tsan dan/ da byid gangs sbal/ bya ma byi zhes khams sogs na yod pha wang la byed pa nor/ dud pa ni khang pa'i dud pa/rgyu zhabs dugs bya zhes me tog grogs (grogakazhing 'ba' cha bya bra gang rigs chang btsos sam sbang ma tshwa btab bsros pa'i dugs/ gong gi mngal du ce 'us tugace'u3bskyal mngal bshal 'di rnams kyi ce 'u (gce'u3ni/ rtsa ba'i sbubs la mthe bong shong pa la/ rtse bug sran ma shong tsam sor brgyad pa zhes bshad pa de yin la/ de ni lcags sam shing la bya/ sman khu ba byed na grod par blug la bskyal/ ril bu byed na nang nas phul la mngal du bskyal lo// rtsa gsher che 'bring chung gsum gang byed kyang / ril bu byed na smug sbubs mtho gang pa zhig gi rtse mor ril bu bzhag la sbu gu'i nang la yar shing phra mo zhig btang de ril bu la btsug mngal nang du mtho gang song ba dang nang gi shing bu de sngon la bton/ sbubs thur rjes la 'don/ tshang ra dang rgyu zhabs la dugs bya/

292 ༄7/karma rat+na'i stan yig gces btus/mar 'ong du ma 'dod na smyug sbubs de mngal du bcug la btsir/ yang ce 'ur (gce'ukyegatong ni grod chung du sman blugs gce'u mtho gang btang / mtho gang ma song na mngal du mi sleb 'gro ma 'dod na smyug ma tshigs par bcad cing rdo la brdar nas zlum por byas la bu snod kyi kha byi'u'i 'phongs 'dra ba zhig yod pa de nad pa rang gi 'dzub (mdzub3mos 'tshol du bcug la sor bzhi btang nas smyug ma'i mgo la mar byugs la des mngal phye/ gzod sman btang mngal gyi lag len sbi/ zhes lag len dmar khrid las so// sbyar thabs lug thung (thong3zhes lug skyes nas lo gsum lon pa tshon po yi glo gsham/ snying gi rtse/ mchin gris (dris 3rtse/ mtsher pa dang mkhal ma g.yas tshil dang bcas pa lte (lto1tshil ni grod pa rgyu long gi tshil/ gzhang kha ni tshil shubs kyi kha/ lce rtsa dang ol gong / men ni dpung pa g.yas pa'i rmen bu/brang ze/ gung rtsib ni gung rtsib bzhi sgal tshigs dang bcas pa/ rlig pa ni g.yas/ mig g.yas/ 'brag sha g.yas/ rkang bzhag g.yas pa/ nywa bzhi zhes 'di rnams brdung tubardungs3/ de nyid sha spyi bsres lug gi sha byin pa spyi dang bsres/ tsha ba ni skyo tsha/ mar chang rus chang ni phyi rgyud ltar du gsungs pa/khrag bcud sbyor ba gnag ces dud 'gro rgod dang lug dang sha ba yi/ smyug shun ni smyug gzhon nu'i phyi shun/ khye'u sus ni chung chung dus med du bsten/'brasasrin ni srin bu ka ka ru/ sbrang bu ram kha tshar sman zhes tshwa sna gsum sle tres bzang po gsum tsha ba gsum btab pa dang phyi rgyud mkhal ma'i grang nad rlung tshabs sel ba'i sman mar de ga yin pa sbyar/le'u don lnga pa/ mo nad bye brag bcos pa/khrag tshabs la ma ra (ru3rtse/ rtse 'u (rtse'u3'greng ni rtse chung rengs pas

294 ༄7/karma rat+na'i sman yig gces btus/ba bre phyed do la mar bre phyed btab sga pi pho kha ru tsha rgyam tsha shing tsha rnams thun log ste btab chu bcad sbrang dang bu ram sbyar la gtang zhes 'byung ngo // rgyab rtsa ni drug 'dus/ mgo yi rlung tshabs dang po lug mgo'i rus pa/ mgo sha ni lug mgo/ sdud sgo ni tshog (mtshog3ma'i 'dus so spyi gtsug ltag pa'i sdud sgo bsreg mgo bcud ni mgo khrol/ thang (thong3tsher ni lug thang (thong3pa dang tsher ma'i (mo'ikye rus pa bsdus khu bar lug thang tsher gyi tshang ra'i sha btab/ tsang (btsongakyeni dmar ram nag po btang / rwa tsha ni bcos ma ste tshwa bzo bdud rtsi'i me long du yod 'dir ma brid pas der rtog go/ dwa tsha shing tsha thug (mthug3po spod sna sga pi pho la la phud 'u su/ 'bras sna a sra 'jam/ khye tukhye'u3sus ni nyung rims (rim3nas cha je cher skyed pa bsten/ se 'bru cur nis ni rgyud phyi ma ltar 'phyi sha dang gong mo'i sha gtong / mdun rgyab ces mdun gyi pho gsang rgyab kyi tshigs bcu gnyis pa me yis mnan/ sgog skya'i sman mar phyi rgyud ltar/ bzhag sha tshil zhes dpe rnying la gzhang sha tshil zhes 'byung /byi sa ni byi khung kha shar lta'i sa/ tsha ba'i ril bu ni phyi rgyud thun gsum ril bu/rjes la pañtsa pha la'i sman mar zhes pa bzang po lnga ste rgyud phyi mar se 'bru 'u su dong gra rtsi (tsi3tra ka pi ling gi mar dang bu ram sbyar/ bzang po lnga yi sman mar bad rlung rgyas// skya rbab gzhang 'brum mcher nad dbugs mi bde// me drod skyed cing lus sha rgyas par byed// bud med bu med pa la'ang bu rnyed 'gyur// zhes/ pa de yin no// sman pa rnams kyi e gong ang / srin langs tsha ba'i nad skyed pa zhes skyes pa dang 'khrig pa bsten/ dril phyis ni khrus byas snum byugs rjes zan la spod btab pa'i dril zhing / phyis zhes pa la mchan bu la lar skyes dar ma lus rngul ba'i dreg pa ril bu byas la btang zhes yang don la gnas pa mi 'dra/ sa bon gyi dwangs ma khong par thang du btang / srin khros 'bru ni sbang skam mam yos/ me tog ni dres ma'i me tog byi rug brgyad pa

༄7/'dod 'byung man ngag yon tan nor bu'i bang mdzod kyi lde mig 295zhes rgyud 'di nyid kyi le'u lnga bcu pa srin bu'i nad gso ba'i skabs su bye rug byi tang ka zhim thig le ke tshe lca ba sne'u 'bam po sha sna bskol khur zhes pa yan lag de yin no// le'u don drug pa/ mo nad phal ba bcos pa/mtshan ma'i nying lo 'byung zhes pa mngal chags nas zla ba bzhi pa'i dus su bu ru 'gyur na ma la chags shing pha la sdang / bu mor 'gyur na pha la chags shing ma la sdang ba'i snang ba 'byung ste/ de nying blo (lo3langs pa zhes pa'i tha snyad btags pa'o// nal bu 'don thabs sman gnyis ni sngon bu sum gnyis khron bu sum cha/ gsum ni 'ol mo thang phrom dkar po dwa ba gsum gyi rtsa ba/ lnga zhes pa ni rgya tsha rgya ru rgya skyegs ri bong ril ma rnams bzhi 'am re re/ nub mo lto dgug rtsa kha phye ba ni nam gyi gung la g.yer ma dang lcam pas rtsa phye/ tho rangs sman de rnams chang sbyar gtang / thun grangs dang de'i yun dang sbyar la bu btsas zhes mngal chags nas zla ba du song gi grangs dang mnyam pas long rtsa dang byin gzhug gtar/ zla bdun man chad kyi nal bu thon par nges pa yin zhes zla ba brgyad kyi sne zin pa man chad mi thon no// nang gi snod ni bu snod/pho yi rmong ni rmong spu/ dugs ni byi khung shar lta'i sa'i dugs/ mde 'byin yu mo mde'u 'byin/ mda' rgyus ni 'ol mo/ cha byad zla kham rgyab ces cha byad zla tshes 'dra ba'i rgur po ngos ltag pa dang ltong kha ngos so yod pa/ gsham du mdzub mo shong tsam pa'i a long btags pa des mthe bong la ko ba mthug po'i dras bstan gyon la bu chung gi lus dam (dum3bur btub(gtubaka/ snam bus skad (sked3bcings la ma de sga'i steng du bzhag la phrag pa gnyis nas mnan/yang na rgya tsha btab pa'i khyi rlig phye ma'i tsha ba ni thug pa phying pa'i snum dugs

296 ༄7/karma rat+na'i sman yig gces btus/zhes rdzong 'phrang du phying pa snum ldan gyi steng du rdo bsregs pas mo mtshan bdug ces 'byung mdzub mos yar 'phul te khyo de'i gos kyi pha (phukadung g.yas pas mo'i phongs su brdeg sngags ni gang gi sngags la 'jug nas yar 'bru log byas te bzlas pa'i sngags chu ma yi khong du btang / rgya tsha rgya ru rmongs (rmong3spu'i gzhob/ yang na rmongs (rmong3spus dod du sngags sam khyi rlig sbyor bas kyang bu ro thon/ g.yer mas ig rgyu bcug ces rdzong 'phrang du g.yer ma khyem gang chang gis phul nas btang bas ig byung des nges par nang du 'gro zhes 'byung / 'phongs bstod nyal zhes lag len dmar khrid du yog pa mgo rdum mdzub mo bas sbom tsam mtho do pa zhig la phru ma sbangs pas nyis rim gsum rim du dril la de la mar byugs/ rgya tsha btab pa'i bu ram gyi ril bur dril ba gcig mgo la bkab la des bu snod lugs pa'i rtse/ ba lang gi sna 'dra ba de yi dkyil du btsug dal bus phul bas bang rim phyi nang log pa bzhin du 'gro/gting du na byung na nang du sleb pa'i rtags yin pas yog pa 'don phyin pa snum ldan glan la drod dugs bya/ mi btsir bar 'phongs stod la nyal lam/bu snod 'jug pa'i lag len lho/ zhes so// ma chod na rtsa khu byug ces bdud rtsi rdzing bur/ ldum bu byang chub ces kyang // bya 'ja' tshon myu gu zhes kyang bya//skye sa lho bal rong du skye// lo ma dres ma gzhon nu 'dra// me tog mchang (mchong3gi bum pa 'dra// rtsa ba gser gyi skor rtse 'dra// rang gi nus pas rtsa kha 'byed// chu 'gags rde nad ma lus sel// me tog mngar gsum sbyar ba yis// bcud len me tog ma lus 'byung // zhes gsungs pa de yin la/ 'di ma rnyed na khu byug rdzi (rtsi3thog zer ba des tshab rung bar bshad/ la la dbyar rtswa dgun bu ('bu3la rtswa khu byug byed par snang yang ches nongs par bas so//ka ra'i skogs ni sngo dwangs srab mo zhig 'ong ba/ ma zhin sbang ma ni chang zhim po'i sbang ma la tsha btab bsros pas 'dug stab seng tig ta'i thang btang ga

༄/'dod 'byung man ngag yon tan nor bu'i bang mdzod kyi lde mig 297bur zhes rgyud phyi mar bdun pa ga bur tsan dan dkar po dang zhes pa'i bar de yin par gser du bshad/ gur gum bdun ni rgyud phyi ma'i mkhris tshad sel ba'i gur gum bdun/ sman zas bsil drod bsnol byas zhes sman dro ba gtong dus zas bsil ba dang sman bsil ba btang du zas drod gtong / de ltar le'u gsum mo nad gso ba ste skabs bcu pa'o// de ltar le'u gsum skabs gcig ni mo nad gso ba ste yan lag gsum pa'o//le'u don bdun pa/ 'byung po'i gdon bcos pa/ya ga can zhes dregs pa can nam mi gtsang bas/ 'bags gtses ni gnod pa byas pa/ brnyas pa ni khyad gsod kyi brnyas pa/ mchod 'os ni dkon mchog gsum dang yi dam mkha' 'gro chos skyong yul lha sogs kyi mchod pa chag pa/ yan lag brgyad par nas/ de yi rgyu ni 'phral gtam ni// sngon chad shes rab 'chal ba yi// blo yis nyes pa byas gyur nas// de yi chags pa sogs bskyed nas// brtul zhugs spyod dang chos lugs nyams// mchod 'os rnams ni brnyas pa dang // gzhung lugs nyams pa de dag ni// sdig dang bdag nyid gsod byed na// gdon ni glags skabs 'tshol byed pas// lha la sogs pas rjes gnod byed// ces gsungs so// mya ngan ni sems mya ngan gyis gdung / mi 'tsham ni spyod pa rtsing po/ yan lag brgyad par nas/gcer bur rgyu'am bla ma smod// 'khrig pa tshul min spyod pa dang // gtsang sbra med pa lha mchod dang // mi gtsang gzhan dang 'dres pa dang // sbyin bsreg sngags gtor mchod sbyin rnams// phyin ci log tu byed pa dang // mdor na nyin re spyod sogs par// spyod pa brtan la bzlog (log3 pa'o// zhes so//lus ngag yid zhugs spyod pa bsgyur// zhes yan lag brgyad par/ 'byung po'i

298 ༄7/karma rat+na'i sman yig gces btus/gzugs dang rang bzhin dang // smra dang 'gro sogs spyod pa dag / gang zhig 'dre bar byed pajams// de la de ni zhugs par bshad// ces so// lus ngagaspyodasmo'agyur zhing de spyod ces yan lag brgyad par/ shes dang rnam shes tshig dang ni// spyod dang snying stobs rang bzhin dag/ gang gi rang bzhin 'gyur ba snang // de la 'byung po'i gdon yod bshad// ces so// lha ni de yi gdon/ sam skṛ ta zhes legs par sbyar ba skad smra/ lha min ni yan lag brgyad par/ lha min yon por blta zhing rang bzhin ngan zhes so// khro gtum nga rgyal bab chol skyicol3mang ni khro zhing rtsol ba che ba dang / dri za ni gartserla/dga' rgyan dmar zhes gos phreng byus/ pa dmar la ster (sred3 zhes so//gnod sbyin ni yak+ṣa/ tshangs pa ni bra rma/ srin po ni rak+ṣa/ sha za ni pi sha rtsa(rtse3/ ngo gnong ni gdong zhum pa dang zhes so// yi dwags ni tre ta/ byad stems shing 'dzin ni shing dang bong pa sogs thog ('dzin ) shing ('dzin )zhes so// g.yeng ni rtsa dkar/ ya tshig ni tshig rtsub smra ba shes par bya zhes so//mtshun lha zhes yan lag brgyad par nas yi dwags mtshun lha'i gdon gyis brtags/ zhes gsungs pa'i yi dwags la la pha mes shi ba der brdzus shing dur du gnas pa dang shi ba de nyid kyi rtags cha lugs bzung nas nye 'brel la bab pa mtshun lha'am shin ngog zhes bya'o// kha skam mig 'dzums g.yon ni g.yon ngos nas ni go gyon zhing zhes so// bla ma ni lha'i bla ma lta bu gu ru/ drang srong ni riṣi dmod pa la dbang ba sidha/ rgan po ni lha sogs bṛta/ grub pa ni rigs sngags 'chang ba/ rang rang gi gnod pa'i rtags ni spyod lam dang kha zas sogs de dang mthun zhes yan lag brgyad par/ bla ma drang srong rgan dang grub// dmod pa sems kyi rjes mthun pas// spyod lam kha zas rang bzhin mas// ji 'dra gdon ni de yin bshad/ ces so// gdon de dag ni zin yang byis pa gzhon nu'i tshogs kyi rjes 'brang zhing zhes so// skra brdzes pa dang blo

༄7khadod 'byung man ngag yon tan nor bu'i bang mdzod kyi lde mig 299sems mi bde ba dang / yun ni lo lon pa phan chad de yun ring por song ba rnams gso mi btub pas spang / bcos thabs ni khro bo'i sngags bzlas gtor ma sbyin pa dang zhi ba drag po'i sbyin bsreg dang / klog 'don ni rgyal ba'i gsung rab/ mnyam par ni sems spros pa dang bral ba/ 'jog pa dang lha'i bsnyen bsgrub dang tshogs gnyis bsags/ 'byung po'i gdon zhes mdo las lha'i bu dbang bsgyur dang bdud ma mo sogs la rigs sngags yod pas de khros nas de mthun gyi cho 'phrul dpag med 'byung bar gsungs pas gdon 'di rnams kyang phal cher rigs sngags sogs log pa grub las byung ba'o// zhi bar byed pa yin zhes yan lag brgyad par nas/ 'byung po'i 'tshe bar mi 'dod dag/ bzlas dang sbyin bsreg gtor ma dang // brtul zhugs tshul khrims mnyam 'jog dang // sbyin bshes brtse la sogs pas bsal// zhes so//gcin drug ni ba glang rta bong ra lug drug gi gcin// gzung (gzungs3grwa lnga so so'i mchod phul gzungs lnga po bsgrags na phan zhes rigs sngags rgyal mo rma bya che// gtsang byas de la rta ru phan zhes so// lha'i khang bzang lha gnas pa'i sa gtang / dri za'i gdon la ba lang zhes pa dus rtag tu rgyu ba'i lam gyi bzhi mdo dang / khyad par rang rang 'dzin pa'i dus su bsten zhes yan lag brgyad par/ lha yi gdon ni yar ngo'i tshes gcig bcu gsum dag la 'dzin/ lha min gdon ni yar ngo yi// bcu gsum mar ngo'i bcu gnyis la// dri za'i gdon ni bcu bzhi dang // bcu gnyis dag la 'dzin par byed// klu gdon tshes lnga la 'dzin byed/ gnod sbyin gdon ni yar ngo yi// tshes bdun bcu gcig dag la 'dzin// tshangs pa srin po yar ngo yi// tshes brgyad bco lnga dag la 'dzin// srin po sha (za3sogs mar ngo yi// tshes gcig tshes dgu bcu gcig la// mtshun lha gnam stong tshes bcu dang // brgyad dang dgu pa dag la 'dzin// rgan po la sogs gzhan dag ni// phal cher de ni thun mtshams la'o//

300 ༄7ོkarma rat+na'i sman yig gces btus/zhes dang / yang de nyid du/ gdon ni nyi ma gang gang la// 'dzin pa'i nyin mor de dang der// mchog tu sbyin bsreg gtor ma sogs// sman pas rab tu 'bad de bya// khrus dang gos dang sha dang tshil// chang dang mar dang bu ram sogs// gang zhig ga la sred gyur pa// de tshe de ni de la sbyin// zhes dang //yang sha za ma gtogs thams cad la// mi mthun sbyin par mi bya ste// mthu stobs che ba de khros nas// nad pa sman pa bcas gsod byed// 'phags pa spyan ras gzigs dbang phyug mgon po phyag ni bcu gnyis pa// nad ni gso bar mdzad pa yi// sngags bzlas pas ni nad kun sel// de bzhin smyo byed brjed byed dang // gzhan yang sems 'khrugs 'joms par byed// ces gsungs so//le'u don brgyad pa/ smyo byed kyi nad bcos pa yid de lam log dran nyams zhes yan lag brgyad par/ 'di yis snying stobs zhan pa yis// snying gi nad la gnod byed de// blo ni dri ma can byas te//yid rgyu ba yi lam bkag nas// smyo byed dag ni skyed par byed// de yi blo dang rnam shes dang // dran pa 'khrul zhing lus kyi ni// bde dang sdug bsngal las nyams te// shing rta kha lo bsgyur ba ni// med pa lta bur bcom pa ni// kun la bsam pa med par byed// ces so// yid gdung ni nor dang chung ma sogs nyes pas yid gdung / bsku mnye ni rlung la bsku mnye dang lums ni rus sna'i lums/ mkhris la skyugs/ bad kan la khrus/ khrag la gtar bas zhes nyes pa gang yang shas che ba de sbyang / 'bras bu gsum zhes dge ba'i sman mar ni a bar skyur/ ha re ṇa ga ni ma nu rta kam ste nu ma 'dra ba mthe bong tsam mdog dmar khung spu yod pa de'o// parnyi zhes pa lo ma'i skad dod yin la bi parnyi zhes

༄7ོkhadod 'byung man ngag yon tan nor bu'i bang mdzod kyi lde mig 301'byung ba shing mngar gyi lo ma dang sdong po gnyis skabs 'dir bzang zhes 'byung / tsan dan zhes tsan dan dkar po zho gang / shug pa ni de ba da ru rnams zho gnyis re 'o ma dang mar rnying pa la sbyar ba sman mar dwangs sbyor ni dge ba'i sman mar zhes/ ro rtsa (tsakalus rgyas smyo byed 'joms zhes smyo byed 'joms pa sogs yon tan mang ngo // de rjes sdig pas skrags (skrag3te yid lam log pa nas thon te rang gnas su 'jug pa srid de/ yan lag brgyad par/ lus kyi sdug bsngal 'jigs pa'am// srog gi 'jigs pa rab 'dzin pas// de phyir kun tu 'khrul pa yis// nye bar zhi bar nyid du 'gyur// zhes so// 'jam rtsi ni phyi rgyud ltar/ btsan dug sman mar ni bong nga nag po zho gcig khram khrum du brdungs pa zhag gcig chang nang du sbangs la skams nas zhib par btags/ a ru ni a ru rgya gar ma'i sha drug 'gyur gyi phye ma chang gis 'dam thag byas nas bskams pa chu bre gsum du bsdus/ de 'o ma dang mar la bskol ba sogs sman mar dwangs sbyor byas pa bzang drug btab bsten thabs ni/ dang po a ru ra tsam btang de nas je cher btang / bya khyung lnga ni rgyud phyi ma ltar de dang cha mnyam dza ti gdab/ yang rdzong 'phrang du/ yang na btsan dug zho phyed a ru zho gnyis bur dkar zho bzhi shing kun rgyam tsha thun re rnams ril bu byas la btang zhes so// dzā ti sman mar dang rus chen ni mi'i rus pa sman mar tshul bzhin bya/ snying rtsa ni snod ka mthong (thong3rtsa/ tig ta'i sman mar phyi rgyud ltar/ sge gsher ni sga rgod dmar po/ rnga bran rtol sha rtsub pa'i zas ni skam sa'i 'bru rnying sbrang rtsi g.yag rgod dang gcan gzan dang chur gnasakyi sha sogs/ yid gdungs ni mya ngan gyi gdungs pa la ni mi rtag pa dang rgyu 'bras kyi chos bshad/ nor ni sbyin pa dang gtam snyan pa dang sems dga' ba'i grogs/ dug la dpa' bo ser po zhes 'di la dpa' bo dkar ser dpa' rgod dang gsum las ser po ste 'khrungs dpe/ dpa' bo ser po zhes bya

302 ༄7/karma rat+na'i sman yig gces btus/ba// sa gzhi 'bol ba'i sa la skyes// lo ma sdong po ba spu 'dra// me tog ser la chung ba ste// rtsa ba khong stong kha dog ser// ro ni kha la bsil ba yin// rang gi nus pas dug rnams 'joms// zhes gsungs la dngos ni deng sang tsā ri sogs su skyes pa 'di bzang ba 'dug go / tsad turtsad1ni lho mon nas 'ong su mi sman zhes pa de la dkar ser dmar gsum yod pa las skabs 'dir ser po bya/ re ral zhes rgyal blon gsum yod pa las 'dir blon po re ral be+e shing la skyes pa de nyid bya/ mkhris sen spu pags bdug zhes 'di'i gdon rgyal lo shas che bas de'i bcos kyang bya'o// zhes gsungs so//le'u don dgu pa/ brjed byed kyi nad bcos pa/brjed byed 'di'i rgyu mtshan ni smyo byed dang mtshungs pas 'dir ma bshad la/ yan lag brgyad par brjed byed dran pa nyams pa ste// de ni snying stobs blo 'khrul dang // sems las mya ngan 'jigs sogs kyis// gnod gyur sems las 'byung ba yin// zhes so// stobs chung la rus shing ni rkang lag gi rus pa na/ yan lag brgyad par// gnyid med skam zhing yan lag na//zhes so// bcos thabs zhes spyir rlung la ni ru ha phyi rgyud ltar la re lcags (lcag3bsnan pa 'dus pa la dug 'don/ skyugs khrus zhes bad kan la skyugs/mkhris pa la khrus/ rno bas (rnon po3ril bu dril ba/ ba ser mkhris zhes yan lag brgyad par/ ba ni ser skya'i mkhris pa yi// sna sman gtang yang mchog tu phan// khyi dang wa dang byi la dang // seng ge sogs kyi mkhris pa bsngags//zhes 'byung ngo // bog yun ring na ni rkang lag gi sor mo nyi shu'i ni'u le dang sen mo'i rtsa ba bsreg myos byed gsang ni nu rgyab tshon gang srog rtsa myos byed gsang zhes thur ma'i skabs bshad pa de yin me rtsa'am (btsa'am3thur ma bya/

༄7/'dod 'byung man ngag yon tan nor bu'i bang mdzod kyi lde mig 303tsha ba'i phugs bcos mi len pa ni gdon gyis bcos mi len pa mang de phyir zhes thog mar sman dpyad zas spyod kyang tsha ba dag par sbyang bar bya/ smyo byed brjed byed phal cher gdon las gyur zhes gdon las gyur pa dang bsdong zla smyo byed la rgyal po/ brjed byed la gza' sogs yod/ bsrung ma la bskang ba dang / bshags pa dang rnam 'joms kyi khrus dang gtor ma gtang ba dang dkon mchog gi bden pa bdar ba sogs zhi bsten/ klu chog gtor ma mdos yas la sogs pa bris la bcos/ des ma thub na drag po'i las ni mnan bsreg 'phang gsum gyi las kyis mtha' ru skyel zhes gsungs so//le'u brgyad cu pa/ gza'i gdon nad bcos pa/tshes bzhi ni ljang sngon ma mo dang bsdong / brgyad ni drang srong dkar ser dgra lha dang bsdong / bcu gcig ni rog ta'i bdud dang bsdong / bco lnga bakhyi srin po dang bsdongs/ bco brgyad la bikhyi btsan dang bsdongs/ nyi shu gnyis su du mjug gshin dang bsdong / nyi shu lnga khyab 'jug glu (klu3 dang bsdong / nyi shu dgu sgra gcan bgegs dang bsdong / rgyu dus chen po brgyad la 'dzin zhes yang na kong rtse 'jug pa'i dus 'dzin pa'ang mthong / kha sle ni kha yo ba/ sen mo gzhob rog 'ong zhes srung mkhan gyis nad pa'i gang phog ngos la sen non par mnan pas sen rjes dmar na me gza' sngo na chu gza'o//srung ba ke tshe zhes 'khrungs dper/ ke tshe lo ma nag la rtsub// sdong po me tog 'bras bu gsum// yungs nag dag dang 'dra ba yin// ro ni tsha la tsub pa ste//nus pas skrangs dang lhog pa 'joms// zhes pa la rigs dkar nag gnyis las dkar po shang tshe nag po ke tshe yin/ ldum rar skyes dri dugs ro tsha dbyibs dpal gang 'dra ba de bas mdog nag spu zhol che bar 'byung nges/ khra

304 ༄7/karma rat+na'i sman yig gces btus/men zhes 'di khyung skyugs kyi rigs dkar khra ser khra dmar khra ljang khra nag khra sogs 'byung gzhi gdan dkar po la khra 'byung bas dkar khra men zer/ gzhi gdan ljang sogs kyi mi nyan/ rmigs pa'i sha ni bye ma smyung ngu / sngags bzlas lus bcang zhes/ oṃ hūṃ ru li khra su su me me shig shig swā hā/ zhes pa 'di dang gzhung gi sngags 'di gnyis ka bzlas zhes gser mchan las gsungs so//ring bsrel zhes rje rang byung ba'i sman ming rgya mtshor rgyal ba'i ring bsrel nor bu'i mchog/ nyan thos rang rgyal byang chub sems// de bzhin rnal 'byor ldan pa'i gdung // zhes so// zin pa'i mdo ni de ma thag rdo mkhris ni rdo ser po ro kha ba mkhris pa 'dra/ ke ta zhes oṃ ke ta ke ta swā hā/ zhes gza'i rang ming yin pas bzlas/ steng nas zhes nad pas ma tshor ba nad pa'i steng nas me dgra chu yin pas chu rdza ma bdun bran/ sngar shul ni nyi grib mtshams der rang du dbul/ chu gzas zin ni chu dgra me yin pas mtha' me yis bskor/thongs kar zhes rgya mthong gi gad sogs/ g.yang sa yod pa/ nad pa'i thad ka'i 'og tu sog 'bol gyi steng / rol mo drag po gang mang dang dung 'bud pa dang nad pa 'bol steng du bskyur/ tsan dan ni dkar po/ dri chu ni sdom brgyad kyi chu/ sgog skya nus ldan bsreg pa dang bsres la chang dang sbyar/ rnam 'joms la sogs ni sme brtsegs gza' yum sogs khrus/ klu chog ces gza'i yum klu yin pas de'i bcos de rjes gza' 'di klu srin gnyis ka'i rigs yin klu la dkar gtor klu sman gyis sbags pa'i chus bran pa/ srin po la dmar gtoragacig sha khrag gis sbags pa chang gis bran pa sngags drug dang phyag rgya drug gis byin rlabs/ de rjes ke ta dang gzhan yang gza'i sngags kyis gtor ma byin/ smrang bkrol ni rgyas bsdus gzhan nas byung ba dag gtor ma phyi rol du skyel btang / nad pa de dang shing shug pa'i spang leb gcig rgyab tu sbragashug pa de la brdog ni kha zhag kha zhag ces brjod cing nad pa de la gtam kha dri/

༄khya/'dod 'byung man ngag yon tan nor bu'i bang mdzod kyi lde mig 305de rnams rang rang gi ming dang snying po bris la rang gi snying gar glan/ nad pa sngo dmar ram gza' so so'i mdog mthun byed gza' rnams kyi gzugs dang sbrel zhes gza' gzugs rnams grib ma chu nang phog par bya/ rā hu la swā hā/zhes drag shaṃm phaṭa tsa shaṃm phags zhes btags pa/ brgya rtsa bzlas zhes de rjes gza' rā hu la'i byad khrol shig byad thag chod cig byas la rā hu la'i byad thag bcad la chu nang du bskyur/ de bzhin du ke ta'i mjug tu rim pa bzhin yag shaṃm phaṭa nyi ma/ dur shaṃm phaṭa zla ba/ seng shaṃm phaṭa mig dmar/ phag shaṃm phaṭa lhag pa/ pher shaṃm phaṭa pa sangs/ shar shaṃm phaṭa spen pa/ trag shaṃm phaṭa/ tsa shaṃm phaṭa 'di gnyis ka rā hu la'i sngags/ spen pa rā hu la sogs so so'i smrang gis bkrol/ sla nga'i rdzas rnams rdza ma'i snod du byo tho rangs chu bo'i gzhung du bskyal/ rgyu dus brgyad po zhes brgyad po 'di gtso che ba'i dbang du byas kyi gzhan yang phyi ltar rgyu ba/ nang ltar rgyu ba/ yang gsang ltar rgyu ba/yab ltar rgyu ba/ yum ltar rgyu ba/ sras ltar rgyu ba/ sprul pa ltar rgyu ba/ phyag brnyan ltar rgyu ba/ pho nya ltar rgyu ba/ 'gyu chen bcu kong rtser 'jug pa pags la'ang sbyar na legs/ klu brgyad kyi cho ga byas te sngar nad kyi zin dus kyi tshe grangs dang rgyu phyogs su/ phug ron ni gson po blud (glud1du byas te gtor ma lhan gcig tu btang / nad pa sos rjes rdo pha wang long bu dang / cho lo ni dung gi sho brgyad kyis nad pa'i mtha' bskor/ dkar khra men dbus su bzhag gza' bsrung gi sngags mang du bzlas pa'i yungs dkar ske ru gdag ces gsungs so// le'u gru gcig pa/ klu gdon gyi nad bcos pa/lan gcig lnga brgya tha ma'i dus zhes deng sang lnga brgya tha ma rang la cung

306 ༄7/karma rat+na'i sman yig gces btus/ma sleb kyang lung gi dus kyi mjug lnga brgya tha ma khad nye ba'o// sangs rgyas byon yang sgron me'i cha nyams/ 'byung ba'i bcud ni sa chu me rlung bzhi bcud shor/mi rnams ni rtsod ldan 'di za thang bri/ sa gnyan ni sa gnyan po don med par brlog spang gi mtha' thams cad zhing 'phrutu'adruka/ chu gnyan po dkrugs/ mi gtsang ba dang dkar dmar sngo'i grib/ thab gzhob ces thab dang sha pags rus bu'i gzhob/ bshan dmar sha khrag rjen pa/ 'jol nyog ni bag med pa spyod/ ban de dang bon po dang sngags pa rnams kyang yi dam gyi nus pa bsgrub lang (long3med/ gnyan na ni sde brgyad gnyan sa'i sa chu shing ri brag sogs dkrugs de tshe klu rigs lnga dang 'byung ba lnga'i gnyan dang sa bdag ni khra bo dang bsgur po dang zha bo dang / 'theng po dang dal sgal dang sba ba can la sogs pa dang gzhan yang lha srin sde brgyad thams cad 'khrugs/ reg pa dang mthong ba dang kha rlangs dang bsam pa'i dug rnams 'phros/ kun dang gson 'bral byed ces gson 'bral byed cing mi rabs rigs rgyud la'ang 'byung ste/yan lag brgyad par khu bar gnas/ bu dang chung ma bcas la 'byung zhes so//lus la gnas pa'i chu ser ni gong du le'u nga dgu par bshad pa ltar/ zas dang spyod lam gyi dbang gis 'du ba ni/ nyes gsum 'khrugs/ de nyid khrag mkhris bsdong pas chu ser nag por gyur nas lus la rgyas/ mi bzad gso dka' mdze nad ces yan lag brgyad par kha zas spyod lam log pa dang zhes pa nas rus pa snyi ba rims (rimakabazhin za zhes pa'i bar gsungs la de nyid las de bas sha bkra phyi rol te// mdze las gzhan ni min par bshade// ces sha bkra yang phyi'i mdze yin gyi nad gzhan min par gsungs pas/ deng sang mdze skya zhes gleng ba 'di nyid yin par sems mod/ sha pags rtsi ni lus mdangs/'dus pa gcig ste bdun las gyes pa ni thod 'dra/ sum cu rtsa drug ni de ltar gnas kyi bco brgyad de rtsa drug go / dang po rmi lam zhes yan lag brgyad par/

༄khadod 'byung man ngag yon tan nor bu'i bang mdzod kyi lde mig 307nad ni stobs dang ldan pa yis/ yid 'jug bu ga bkag pa'i phyir/ mi bzad rmi lam mthong bar 'gyur zhes so// ni'u tune'u1gsing rnams ni gtad du tshud pa'i rtags/ gcan gzan rnams kyis ded pa rnams gdon gyi rtags/g.yang lhung ni mnan par tshud rtags/ mda' dang zhes byad kha spyi'i rtags/lder bso kyibazo1'gul ni pho gdon gyi rtags/ lus zungs 'byin pa ni mo gdon gyi rtags/ bkrag phrogs ni med pa'am yang na bkrag cher skyes pa pags pa gas pa dang mes tshig bsnad pa'i rma rnams mi sos par yun ring gnas/ ngag gi brtag pa 'gyur ldog mang zhes res cher res chung res phra res sbom res 'gags res gsang (bsengakab sogs mang / yid la brtag pa ni snying bcus skyigacus3pa ltar mchu ('chu3zhing sems mi dga' bar 'phyo/ khro ba dang tshig pa za ba dang 'gro 'dod gong gi rtags de rnams la gzhan 'chad mi 'dod pa gsang bar thub/ me long 'dra ba zhes gsal bar 'ong bas chus bkrus/ de yang me tog yod par chu mi 'chags/ mthe bos mnan rjes zhes mnan rjes dang skya smrag sogs kyi thig le 'ong / me tog ces med par sha rus sogs skam na dus 'das/ mi gnod pa yi rtsa zhes rtsa ris mig bkrag mdangs legs shing mig rtsa rnams rangs na dmar sing nge ba steng du don/ gdon pa'i rtsa ris mig mangs (mdangs3nyams mchi ma 'dzag me nyi'i 'od mi thub mig rtsa rnams dmar nag gting du bying rtse mo gug rgyal mo la kha lta nag nog bkal ba 'ong / yan lag lnga gang la bzung ni gdon rigs brtag 'jug tshul ni rtsa dra (pra1la brtag lus kyi zhugs sa ni mig gi yas mas nas brtag pa/ thub dang mi thub ces g.yas g.yon gyi mig rtsa la brtag lo grangs zhes dkar nag mtshams kyi ri mo'i grangs dang brtag rang mdog las gnod mi gnod brtag ces brtag pa la rdzong 'phrang du/ mu zi ser po gur (gu3gul gla rtsi shu dag bzhi dang so ga'i spum mgo 'bur btus pa cha mnyam zhib btags ras

308 ༄7/karma rat+na'i sman yig gces btus/kyis btums rgya tsha dum zhig kyang bcug nad pa'i dri chus sbangs pa zhag gsum skom du btang / tha ma brtsir (btsir3gyi khu ba thon par byas la btung /skom gzhan spang / des dri chu'i mdog ma 'gyur na gdon mi mchod (gnod3pa yin/ chu ser sna tshogs byung na gnod pa yin/ khrag tu byung na mi thon pa yin zhes bshad do/ 'gong po skyi la 'bab na ni ba spu'i rtse g.ya' grang sing byed/ dam sri pags la 'bab thor phran 'ong gdang pa dmar sbo byed/ sa bdag sha ma 'dzin ni skor /ko1ler na sha ro 'gul 'phrig 'ong / gnyan ni rtsa la babs za 'phrug byed khrag rgyas/ rigs drug chu rgyus rigs 'dzin zhes rkang lag zha 'khums lus gyong / rgyal rigs yid dug ces 'byung bzhi 'dus pa'i dug ces yin/ gtsug nas 'jug ces spyi gtsug tu sha ro 'ong / rmi lam gang rmi yang phal cher kha dog dkar po rmi/ dug ni me yin te rtsa nas 'jug ces mchin par 'bab dmar po rmi/ bram ze kha rlangs dug yin lag g.yon zhes g.yon nas 'jug mkhal ma g.yon par 'bab ser po rmi/ reg dug ni rlub yin rkang g.yas 'jug ces yan lag dang sor mo rnams byi gzhug 'dra skad 'dzer sngon po rmi/ gdol pa mche ba'i dug ni sa yin rkang pa g.yon nas 'jug mtsher pa 'bab na sa rmi/ mjug tu klu gang yin de yi rgyal po don la 'bab ces rje rigs me khams snying la 'bab/ bram ze chu khams mkhal mar 'bab/ dmangs rigs rlung khams mchin par 'bab/ gdol pa sa khams mtsher pa 'bab/ rgyal rigs 'dus pa nam mkha'i khams glo bar 'bab ste don lnga/ so so dang 'brel ba'i dbang po gang yin de yang nyams par byed do//ku re kyal ka'i tshul zhugs ni rtags res 'ong res mi 'ong zas spyod gzab/re 'dod tshul zhugs pa ni blo bur du 'ong rmi lam za zi mang tshogs gsog bya/mi gtsang sgo zhugs ni shes pa 'thib/ do bsdo sems zhugs ni gnad las zin pas bsnyen bsgrub dang sman ltag sprod bya/ las kyi rnam smin tshul zhugs ni gong

༄7/'dod 'byung man ngag yon tan nor bu'i bang mdzod kyi lde mig 309du spang ba'i rtags shar ba ste dge ba la bskul/ pags pa gyong mdog 'gyur rtsa mdangs nyams/ mdog la zhugs ni gdong mdog 'gyur/ stobs ni shad (shed3nyams pa/ sha ni 'gul 'phrig tshor ba chung / tshil (rdzud pa3chu ba gyong zhing na/ sbrid bshal 'khyug rtsa dang khrag gdong dmar sna khrag 'dzag chu ser ni za 'phrug chu bur 'ong / rus ni sha skam gzer/ tshigs ni 'khor skrangs/lha ba ni sgyid skyur grang sil byed/ glad (klad3zhugs ni mgo 'thom skra byi/rkang ni sbrid 'gas dang khu ba ni skam sam 'joms/ don zhugs rtags snying ni sems dag g.yeng lce dmar/ glo ba ni skad 'dzer sna chu 'ong / mchin pa ni 'thib gnyid che mchi ma mang mig sla dmar/ mtsher pa ni mchu skya lce khra gdong skya bor 'gro/ mkhal zhugs ni rna ba 'on rkang ba bshal rlig pa skrangs par brtag par bya/ babs sa de dag mdor bsdus/ rlung mdze thod 'dra ni nag cing srug mkhris mdze u dum wa ra smin pa ltar dkar smug bad kan zlum po g.ya' zhing rnag che/ glang shu g.ya' zhing chu ser mang / ldan pa ri shi lce zhes zug che tsha la rnag dang 'brum bu mang zhing tsub pa yin/ bad rlung pags mdze glang po'i lpags pa ltar reg bya tsub/ 'brum phran ni 'brum pa mang ba nya lpags 'dra/ sha bkra ni nag tsub dmar dkar za 'phrug byed 'bras ni spen bu dmar rkang lag gas pa/ bad mkhris shu ba ni thor pa dmar po can/ rma kha ni rma kha mang zhing rnag mang ba/ bad dkar ni dbus dkar mtha' dmar/'brum bu ni pags srab 'brum pa dkar nag 'dus gyur 'ol ma (mokyese 'dra ni 'brum pa'i stod dmar nag nor sa'i 'phrang ni nywa rtsa rlung gdon 'phrig pa nor ra re zhes nywa 'phrig ni nywa sul gang (nya3yod du 'ong / rtsa 'phrig ni snying rtsa yod par 'ong / rlung 'phrig ni lus kun khyab par 'ong / 'di gsum ni nad gzhan la'ang 'byung / gdon 'phrig ni zhugs pa dang gnyan par 'ong ba'o// sha 'bur ni shu ba rul 'gro/ srin 'bur ni rang zhi'am rnag tu 'gro/

310 ༄7/karma rat+na'i sman yig gces btus/gting 'bur ni rus las thon je cher 'gro/ sha sgang ni kha rlangs yin nyal nyil 'ong / nywa sgang ni mdog dmar na tsha med/ chu sgang ni chu bur 'ong me tog yin/ sha ro ni bar du 'byung lo gsum lon/ pags pa dang skyi ni ro phyi ru 'byung lo gnyis/ rus ro zhes pa tshor ba med pa'i don/ kha yo ba dang / mig yo ba dang sle ba gnyis khad kyi byung na gso dka' blo (glo1bur du byung na gso sla ba nor ra re/ nad ni zug rtag par 'byung ba dang khams 'dus pa ni yong tshe (tshor bkami 'byung gdon gsum nor/ kyal ka ni snying mi dga' rtags res 'ong res mi 'ong / re 'dod ni yas 'dod pa ste kha yo mig sle ru yong / rnam smin ni las 'bras yin (smin3pas de bskul bya/ do brdo ba ni khong (khro3dang 'dres yod pas gsod par brtson pas sngags sman gnyis ka bya/ zas ni za 'phro dang skam tuskom1ni 'thung 'phro spyod lam 'dres pa gnas 'dres pa mal 'dres gos 'dres pa la sogs/ dri ni mdor na nad pa de'i dri dang reg pa bsrung zhes ni yan lag brgyad par/ nad rnams phal cher zas dang ni//mal gcig reg sogs la brten nas// thams cad 'go ste mig nad dang /mdze ni lhag par 'go ba yin// zhes so// mkhar pa ni khro tshig snying mi dga'/brgyad rtse bcom pa zhes spyi btsug smin dbrag sna rtse ya rkan snying ga lte ba chu so rkang mthil rnams su sha ro 'byung ba dang / snying po bzhi zhugs ni rkang lag gi mthe bo bzhi la sha ro 'byung ba dang / tshigs chen zhes thams cad la skyon zhugs te 'phrul ba/ dug bzhi ni sa chu me rlung bzhi sngar dug rigs brtag pa'i skabs bshad/ mdangs gsum ni mig mdangs te gzi 'dra/ byad mdangs yal te glo bu 'dra/ so mdangs yal te dung 'dra ba/ spu gsum ni skra smin ba spu byi/ chu gsum ni kha sna mig gsum chu bo/ rgya mtsho dri chu'i rlangs/mkhal mar rgyas zhes sngar bshad pa ltar klu'i rgyal po don la babs pa mthil ni rkang lag gi mthil bzhi la sha ro 'byung ba yod pas rngul dang rlangs pa yal/

312 ༄7/karma rat+na'i sman yig gces btus/ston dpyad dbyar ston gyi ra ba bzhi la lan re sbyang / mdze nad kyi rgyu rkyen chu ser med par ma byas na 'bras bu mdze sos pa'i thu ga la 'byin/ mngar gyi rnam pas srin skyed pa dang / zas rul ba mi 'ju skyur bas ni chu ser skyed/ tsha (tshwas3bas ni khrag skyed/ sngo tshod kyis rtsa sgo 'gag 'jig zas ni nya phag gi sha dang bra bo rnams kyis lus rkyen bskyed pas spang / 'bru rnying sha gsar pa dang yib ni rul ba dang tsha ba ni phye thug tshwa rdor med pa/ sings po'i brda bro ni chang gi zhad yod tsam pa bsten/ mi gtsang ni grib btsog gnyan pa'i sa phyogs su thub chod spyod pa rtsing po byed pa kun la 'dzem/ chig thub gnyis ni sbal 'brum med pa'i dkar smug gnyis/ be snabs ni dkar la dmar sna ring 'jam pa zhig yod de ngo e shes sam/ gru bzhi ni rdo sho/ rdo rgyus ni dkar po dngos 'dra/ mardzi ra ni mchin pa 'dra ba mchog sran ma gang zlum 'dra ba tha ma'o// gser rdo dngul rdo zangs rdo lcags rdo/ mu zi ni ser po/ ming can ni lhog dug pa/ bya khyung lnga ni a ru gser mdog gi nag chung zho bzhi/ ru rta zho gcig shu dag nag po zho gang gi sum gnyis/ bong nga nag po zho phyed/ gla rtsi 'brum pa can zho gang gi sum cha gcig rnams sbyar btsan dug ces btsan dug bong nga zhes pa 'di la spyir dug yod med gnyis/ dug med la bong nga dkar ser dmar gsum/ dug yod pa la'ang dkar ser nag po gsum las/dkar po ni me tog sngo skya can rtsa ba dkar sab yod pa de la ra dug pa zer/me tog sngo bsangs (sang3rtsa ba ser ngar yod pa la btsan dug gi 'bri tshil ma zer/ me tog mthing nag rtsa ba nag po thang chu yod pa de la ha la nag po zer ba yin/ 'bru lnga'i dbang ni oṃ hūṃ ṭ+wāṃ hri ā/ bya khyung phyag rdor gyi ting 'dzin dang ldan pa sman gza'(bza'1/ tshes gcig nas bcu'i bar ril bu re/tshes bcu nas nyi shu'i bar ril bu gnyis re/ nyi shu nas sum cu'i bar ril bu gsum gsum nub mo sum yar du btang de lta bu nad thog mar zhugs dus

396 ༄7/karma rat+na'i sman yig gces btus/le'u go gnyis pa/ bu med pa btsal ba/ro tsa'i yan lag ces yan lag gi rgyu bud (bu3med btsal thabs la ni/bu rtsi btang zhes bu mi 'byung ba'i sman btang ba'am/ har por zhes mngal gyi kha har por yod par sems shing skabs su mngal khrag sdom zhing rgyu zhabs sbo/mkhrig tumakhris1pa zhes rgyu zhabs tsha 'brab byed cing mngal khrag dud khu dang /bad kan gyi ni bsil zhing mngal khrag 'o kha'am chu 'dra/ phyi yi rtsa gsher zhes gong du mo nad kyi bcos ltar bya/ mar bcud ces gong gi mo nad spyir gso ba'i mar bcud sbyor ba/ mkhris pa dang bad kan zhes me tog sna tshogs kyi dugs kyis rgyu zhabs su bdug khrus gsher chen mo zhes gong gi mo nad spyi bcos kyi mngal skyon bsal/ gang yin gyur zhes bu ro nad ro gang yin gyur kyang bu chags pa bzhin du 'dril/ bya bra zhes phug ron brun/ grog zhing ni khang thog tu chags pa'i spang rnam pa can des rgyu zhabs bdug de nas a ru mchu smyung gcig dwa tsha ni shing tsha mthug po/ rtsab shing ni lcum rtsa/ dur byid ces dur byid zho gang / khron bu ril ma tsam/ 'ol mo zho gang / rgya tsha zho gang /shing tsha zho phyed btab la tho rangs dus na btang / rgya tsha phru dregs (dregakyezhes phru ba'i dreg pa cha gnyis/ 'ol mo cha gsum/ sha rus thal ba cha bzhi/ yang na zhes tsha ba gsum bre phyed/ a ru lnga/ rgyam tsha sho tsam/ dwa tsha zho gang / lcum rtsa zho gang rnams so sor chur bsdus/ dur byid mdzub mo tsam/ 'ol mo lug ril tsam/ rgya tsha zho gang / shing tsha zho phyed btab/ zug gzer skyes na zhes pho bar rdo dugs dang rgyu zhabs su 'bru dugs/ gal te sbyongs kyis ma phig pa rgya tsha chang dang sbyar la btang / rtsa gsher chen mo ni rgyud 'di'i mo nad spyi bcos skabs kyi sbyar/ bu rtsi btang bas zhes mngal khrag chad dam mngal khrag rtag tu

legs zhig dgos zhes yang yang bskul bar brten/ kha sab 'os dang tshig sna cung zad bsring 'os rnams de ltar bgyis nas don gyi char zhus dag bcas legs par grub pa'i byed pa po ni karma rat+na zhes 'bod pas rang gshags dbe+en pa zla mdzes su bkod pa dge'o// / /
